original: Weekend closure: the option is closed by an authority whose closure works only if it is not announced, since the announcement would be the signal to exercise, so the exit is shut in the hours the holder cannot act, as the Greek banks that did not open on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday address, the Cypriot bank holiday of March 2013 that was extended, after parliament refused the first levy, until the bail-in was law, the Argentine corralito announced on a Saturday in December 2001, and the export-licence suspension or the delisting published after the fact; the condition lost is a permission, the leave to move what is yours; the carrier is the authority's calendar aligned to the hours the holder is shut out, the Friday night and the bank holiday; the last intervention that could have kept it is a transfer made on rumour, at the price of being wrong and of the discount the rumour market charges, since the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing better; so this is the one expiry on the map whose notice cannot precede it, and a holder who waits for a date is waiting for a thing the mechanism forbids; adds to runway-illusions' Cash behind glass, which counts the deposit taken into receivership on a Friday as owned and unreachable, the mechanism that chose the Friday; not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse the founder can test by letting it pass, since a closure that can be probed is not one that must be a surprise, and not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, which a party at the holder's own table decides, since the decree is an authority's rule on a class and nobody at the holder's table decided about the holder; the item is in on that fence and not on any claim that the exit dies as a side effect, since the decree forbids the exit by name.

Bar date in the newspaper: the claim expires on a date fixed in a proceeding the holder is not attending and is deemed to have read, as the bankruptcy court's bar date for proofs of claim, noticed to unknown creditors by publication, the class settlement whose opt-out date arrives on a postcard that looks like advertising, and the probate creditor's window after the notice runs in the county paper; the condition lost is a permission, the standing to be paid or to sue on one's own; the carrier is the bar-date order together with the rule of constructive notice, under which publication counts as knowledge for anyone the debtor could not name; the last intervention that could have kept it is a one-page proof of claim or a signed opt-out, the cheapest filing in the law and the one least often made, since the holder who would make it is by construction the one who was not told; adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a permission with a date the holder can read on the stamp, the date that is written on someone else's docket and imputed to the holder; not deal-deaths' Missing witness, since nothing is missing from the record, only the holder from the room.

Emergency over: the option was granted under a parent instrument with a term of its own, so it expires when the parent does, whatever its own merits and with no date printed on it, as the emergency-use authorization that ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing, the cross-state telehealth licence that lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022, the wartime power, the pilot programme run under a waiver, the sub-lease that dies with the head lease; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the parent instrument's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read, since the grant it did read carried no date, and the holder must first find which parent paper carries it; the last intervention that could have kept it is conversion, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in one's own name, filed while the parent still stands, and the conversion is slow enough that it must be started while the emergency looks endless, which is exactly when nobody starts it; not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date is on a docket and imputed, since here the date is on a different paper than the option and is honest, and not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes, since here the rule does not wait but ends.

Patch before seven: the option expires by the holder's own development, on a schedule the holder cannot know, so the last intervention is necessarily in another hand, as amblyopia, which is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years and responds less, and less completely, after about seven, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens, the clubfoot cast in infancy, the second language spoken without an accent, which is contested as a hard window, the duckling that imprints in its first day; the condition lost is a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire; the carrier is the developmental timetable, and the holder is a child who does not know there is an eye to save; the last intervention that could have kept it is a screening, the preschool vision check and the parent who notices a squint, so the option belongs to one person and its preservation to another, and where no screening programme exists the option expires unseen at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of the child; adds to Last known well, where a witness dates the option, the case where the option's holder cannot be its own witness at all; not a use-it-or-lose-it, since nothing the child does or leaves undone runs the clock.

Last known well: the option is dated by the last witness to the fact rather than by the fact, so it expires when the proof runs out while the body might still allow it, as the stroke patient who wakes with the deficit and is ineligible for thrombolysis because the four-and-a-half-hour window is counted from when she was last seen well, which was bedtime, so the wake-up stroke lost the drug regardless of when the artery closed; the same rule dates the opened vial with no time written on the label and the sample whose chain of custody has a gap, which are treated as expired at the earliest time they could have been; the condition lost is a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids; the carrier is the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue; the last intervention that could have kept it is a witness, someone awake, a time written on the vial, or a witness of a different kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 returned the drug to patients with no witnessed onset; adds to witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, the option that dies for want of a trace while the fact would still allow it; not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run, since here the body's clock may not have run and the record's has.

Mooted: the option to a decision expires because the situation resolves itself faster than the forum that would decide it moves, so nobody declines and nobody rules, as the student whose challenge to a law school's admissions was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974), the pregnancy over before the appeal, the election held before the ballot-access case, the tenant evicted before the housing court sits, the employee whose grievance is mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post; the condition lost is a permission, the justiciability of the claim; the carrier is the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number no party at the table sets; the last intervention that could have kept it is a structure that outlives the individual harm, the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which is what Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, which is what Roe rested on, so the option is kept by a coordination or by a rule and never by hurrying; not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where the surplus is eaten on a curve, since here nothing is eaten and the harm is simply over, and not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date anywhere.

Session ends: the body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter pending, and its successor never has to say no, as the bills that die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from the beginning, the treaty signed and awaiting a parliament that is dissolved, the permit application before a council that is re-elected, the approval the old board agreed in the hallway and had not yet minuted when the board was reconstituted at the meeting, the offer approved by a committee that is disbanded in the reorganization; what expires is the matter's place in the process, since the successor body starts it at zero; the condition lost is a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available; the carrier is the ratifier's own calendar, election, session, or term; the last intervention that could have kept it is the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway; the treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone, and the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no; adds to deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain, the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote; not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer, since here it is replaced by the calendar.

Landlord changes: an option held in a person rather than on the paper that transfers expires at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder does not control and often does not see, as the renewal promised by the landlord who sells the building to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises, the 'we'll take you back' from a manager who leaves, the side letter with a fund's partner that the fund's successor manager has never seen, the supplier's verbal priority that vanishes with the account executive; the condition lost is a counterparty, the one whose word held the option; the carrier is the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, on which the option was never written, so the successor takes free of it; the last intervention that could have kept it is recording, a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put on the paper that binds successors, which costs the awkwardness of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement; adds to term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have, the mirror case, where the replacement declines to honour a term the friend gave; not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.

Chair grown over: the option to return rests on a vacancy that the counterparty has not yet re-planned, so it expires at the counterparty's next planning cycle without anyone declining the return, as the leave taken with no return date whose post is redistributed among three people at the next reorganization, the budget line reallocated at year end, the supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed, the co-founder's seat that the remaining founders stop leaving empty at the next hire; what expires is the return to the seat, since employment there afterwards is a new negotiation from the outside; the condition lost is a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could receive the holder; the carrier is the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, which sets the expiry without reference to the holder at all; the last intervention that could have kept it is a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle must respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns; adds to traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant, where preparation for a future breeds its opponents, the case in which no one opposes the return and the absence is simply absorbed; not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way, since this road has closed.

Petition that goes stale: an option that requires many simultaneous yeses expires unless the gathering outruns the decay of each yes, so a coordination has a half-life, as the recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days, the tender offer's minimum condition that must be met by the offer's expiry, the crowd in the square that goes home, the reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time; the condition lost is a coordination; the carrier is the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention; the last intervention that could have kept it is a gathering rate, paid circulators, a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives; the recall and tender cases are observed and the crowd is analogy; adds to who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving, the coordination lost by others' leaving; not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter, since here many small calendars do.

Outgrown the buyer: the holder's own growth moves the counterparty out of reach, so the option to sell to the natural acquirer expires at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all, a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling, with nobody at either table declining, as the company whose preference stack now exceeds the largest deal its three strategic buyers have ever done, the player whose wage outgrows every club in the league but two, the practice too large for any partner to buy in and too small to be listed; the condition lost is a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option; the carrier is the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and its deal history, set against the holder's own price, which each round raises; the last intervention that could have kept it is the sale at the last price under the ceiling, which was never seen as the last, or a round sized to stay under it, which is the one choice a founder is never advised to make; analytical, since every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more, so the item stands as a mechanism and not a count; adds to market-deaths' Slowed past the rot, where a market thins from the outside, the market for the holder that the holder thins by growing; not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans, since here the counterparty is unchanged and the holder has left its range.

Pour the foundation: a permission is about to be withdrawn by a third party's rule change, and it can be kept only by an act in the world that no paper substitutes for, as the building that may proceed under the old zoning only if the developer has substantially begun in reliance on a valid permit before the ordinance passes, the footings poured the week of the council vote, the nonconforming use that survives the new code only if it is in use on the effective date, the grandfathered rate kept only by the account that was open; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the code and the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application, so the last act differs by jurisdiction and the holder who knows which has a different week; the last intervention that could have kept it is the hole in the ground before the vote, which is an exercise begun rather than a filing made, so the option can be preserved only by starting to use it; adds to first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose, the rule that changes for reasons of its own; not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated to keep the right, since here one beginning vests it for good.

Slot flown empty: the permission expires by disuse and is kept only by exercise, so the clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the preserving act is the exercise emptied of its purpose, as the airport slot that must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, which had airlines flying empty aircraft in early 2020 until the rule was waived, the water right under prior appropriation forfeited after five years without beneficial use, which has fields irrigated in a drought to keep them, the trade mark abandoned after three years' non-use, the mining claim kept by annual labour, the department budget spent in the last quarter so that it is not cut; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is the regulator's usage ledger; the last intervention that could have kept it is the empty flight, which costs the whole price of using the option and returns nothing but the option, so that keeping and using become the same act and the option's upkeep is its exercise price; adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapses without hours logged and whose clock no cash extends, the price at which it can be extended after all, the hours flown for nobody; adds to tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp, the permission-holder who must burn the permission to keep it, and to power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved, the disuse that forfeits it by rule; not Pour the foundation, one act that vests, since here no act ever finishes the keeping.

Thawed to be ready: preparing to exercise the option starts a decay the unprepared state did not have, so the option to wait expires because the option to act was made ready, as the vaccine vial that keeps for months frozen, weeks once thawed, and hours once punctured, the epoxy whose pot life begins at mixing, the drawn dose, the armed fuze, the reagent brought to room temperature, the opened surgical field, the reserve army that cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from; the condition lost is a capability, the good itself spoiling in its ready state; the carrier is a chemistry, or a season, that begins at preparation; the last intervention that could have kept it is not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit, the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings, so the clinic that thaws a tray to be sure of serving whoever comes has bought readiness with the doses it will discard at closing; the mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched, since here it dies of being touched, and a holder who holds both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other; not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting, since the understudy does not spoil for having been rehearsed, and not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day, since here it falls on the good.

First or never: the option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is the holder's own next act rather than a date, and a holder who does nothing keeps it while a holder who does anything adjacent loses it, as the objection to the court's jurisdiction over the defendant that is waived if left out of the first response, the patent that is dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States, the appeal waived by accepting the settlement, the election of remedies, the defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used, the 'speak now' at the wedding; the condition lost is a permission; the carrier is a rule that binds the option to a position in a sequence, and the sequence is written in a different place than the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code, so the holder learns the order from the loss; the last intervention that could have kept it is the ordering itself, the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the goods are unpacked, each of which costs nothing but the knowledge that an order exists; not Slot flown empty, where the holder's inaction runs the clock, since here inaction is the only thing that keeps it, and not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date and the holder is the only one who can strike.

Rollback horizon: the option to reverse a move expires at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read, so the window is the pause between the change and its first consequence and it closes without anyone deciding to close it, as the migration that can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects, the merger reversible until the first combined payroll, the new address reversible until the first piece of mail arrives there, the reorganization reversible until the first hire is made into the new chart, the currency changeover until the first contract is written in the new unit; the condition lost is a capability, the old state's ability to take over from here; the carrier is the first write, which is performed by the new state in the ordinary course and is not a decision about the reversal at all; the last intervention that could have kept it is the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so that the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth; adds to pivot-invariants, which name the retained assets that make leaving cheap, the moment at which one of them is lost, and to undo-costs, which bills a reversal that remains possible, the reversal that stops being possible; not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good, since here the new state's use closes the way back to the old.

Kept on the machine: the option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm or whose lapse is one-way, so the deadline is the machine's and not the situation's, as the patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant who becomes ineligible for the transplant the machine was keeping her alive for, since bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit and centres set a duration beyond which candidacy is reviewed, the mothballed mine kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening, the ship in the reserve fleet whose hull is kept by cathodic protection that a budget line can end, the interim chief who has run the company past the point where the search can bring in an outsider; the condition lost is a capability, the eligibility or the workings; the carrier is the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill; the last intervention that could have kept it is a listing at the moment of cannulation, a search begun the day the interim was named, a decision to stop pumping taken while a sale was still possible, each of which treats the bridge's start as the option's deadline; the ECMO limits are centre practice and are simplified; adds to lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour, the bridge that ends the option it holds open; not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs, since here the clock is a harm nobody signs.

Standstill with a term: a pause taken to keep an option open is written on a paper with a date, so a situation that had no deadline acquires one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who now knows what the pause is worth to the holder, as the tolling agreement that stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing and that expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again, the negotiated leave of absence that dates a job which had no date and is extended only if the employer signs, the forbearance agreement that holds the lender's foreclosure for ninety days, the furlough whose recall rights run six months, the standstill in a takeover that keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says; the condition lost is a permission, the leave to remain in the paused state; the carrier is the pause's own instrument, and its clock is the only clock in the situation that the holder wrote; the last intervention that could have kept it is the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, which is rarely granted, since the Korean armistice is the exception that has no renewal date and is still called temporary; the statutory pauses, the twelve weeks of the family-leave statute and the restraining order's fourteen days, are the same date without the mechanism, since the term is a rule's and the renewal belongs to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it, and they are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock; adds to impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip, the bill the chip carries; not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search, since here the search is stopped and the stopping is what expires.

A: Closed by decree on a class. Mechanism: a permission to move what is yours (deposits, exports, a listing) is taken not from the holder but from the whole class, by an authority whose silence the permission lived on, and timed for hours in which the holder cannot act. The announcement and the shutting are one act, because the announcement would be the signal to exercise and the closure only works unannounced. Carrier: the authority's own calendar, laid across the Friday night and the bank holiday. Threshold: none the holder can read; this is the one expiry whose notice cannot precede it, and it cannot be probed by letting it run, since a closure that can be tested is not this one. Cases: Greek banks open Friday, closed Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday address; the Cypriot bank holiday of March 2013 extended after parliament refused the first levy until the bail-in was law; the Argentine corralito announced on a Saturday in December 2001; an export licence suspended and a delisting published after the fact. Tell: the permission is held by class, it lives on an authority's silence, and the authority has reason to close it unannounced. No party at the holder's own table decides anything; this is not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, and not a right that asking could have kept. Last act that keeps it: a transfer made on rumour, paid for in the chance of being wrong and in the discount the rumour market charges; the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing better. Changed next move: stop waiting for a date, because the mechanism forbids one; act on rumour or accept the class closure. Relation: runway-illusions' Cash behind glass counts the deposit taken into receivership on a Friday as owned and unreachable; this item is the mechanism that chose the Friday. The option is closed by name, not as a side effect.

Bar date in the newspaper. Mechanism: the standing to be paid, or to sue in one's own name, ends on a date fixed in a proceeding the holder is not attending, under a rule that deems the holder to have read the notice. Carrier: the bar-date order joined to the rule of constructive notice, under which publication counts as knowledge for anyone the debtor could not name. Cases: the bankruptcy court's bar date for proofs of claim, noticed to unknown creditors by publication; the class settlement whose opt-out date arrives on a postcard that looks like advertising; the probate creditor's window once the notice has run in the county paper. Threshold: the date on someone else's docket, imputed to the holder. Tell: you are an unknown creditor or an absent class member; the notice is in a paper you do not read or a mailer you would throw away. Last act that keeps it: the smallest filing in the law, a one-page proof of claim or a signed opt-out, the cheapest filing there is and the one least often made, because the holder who would make it is by construction the one who was not told. Changed next move: treat legal-notice mail and published notices as dated instruments; search for proceedings in which you may be an unnamed creditor. Relation: not deal-deaths' Missing witness, since nothing was missing from the record; only the holder was missing from the room. Beside runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, where the permission carries a date the holder can read on the stamp, this is the date written on someone else's docket.

Dies with the parent. Mechanism: a permission that carries no date of its own, granted under a parent instrument that has a term; when the parent ends, the permission ends with it, on its merits or against them, with nothing printed on its face to say so. Carrier: the parent's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read, since the grant the holder did read carried none. Cases: the emergency-use authorization, which ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing; the cross-state telehealth licence that lapsed with each state's emergency through 2021 and 2022; the wartime power; the pilot programme run under a waiver; the sub-lease that died with the head lease. Threshold: the parent's term, which the holder first has to locate, since the question is which parent paper carries the date. Tell: the grant's face is undated and it names an instrument it was issued under. Last act that keeps it: conversion, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in one's own name, filed while the parent still stands; conversion is slow enough that it has to start while the emergency looks endless, which is the season nobody starts it. Changed next move: on receipt of any undated grant, find the parent paper and its date, and start conversion before the parent looks mortal. Relation: not Bar date in the newspaper, whose date sits on a docket and is imputed; here the date is on a different paper than the option and is honest. Not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes; this rule does not wait, it ends.

Patch before seven. Mechanism: a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire, expires by the holder's own development on a schedule the holder cannot know, so the last act that can keep it is necessarily in another hand. Carrier: the developmental timetable; nothing the child does or leaves undone runs it, so this is not a use-it-or-lose-it. Cases: amblyopia is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years and responds less, and less completely, after about seven, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens; the clubfoot cast in infancy; the second language spoken without an accent, contested as a hard window; the duckling that imprints in its first day. Threshold: roughly seven for amblyopia, with a tail into the early teens; infancy for the cast; the first day for imprinting. Tell: the holder is a child who does not know there is an eye to save; the option belongs to one person and its preservation to another. Last act that keeps it: a screening, the preschool vision check, the parent who notices a squint. Where no screening programme exists the option expires unseen, at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of the child. Changed next move: fund and run the screening; the holder cannot be its own witness. Relation: beside Last known well, where a witness dates the option, this is the case in which the holder cannot witness at all.

Last known well. Mechanism: a capability is dated not by the fact but by the last witness to the fact, so it expires when the proof runs out while the tissue might still take the drug. Carrier: the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue. Cases: the stroke patient who wakes with the deficit is ineligible for thrombolysis because the four-and-a-half-hour window is counted from when she was last seen well, which was bedtime, so the wake-up stroke loses the drug regardless of when the artery closed; the opened vial with no time written on the label and the sample whose chain of custody has a gap are both treated as expired at the earliest hour they could have been. Threshold: four and a half hours from last seen well for thrombolysis; for the vial and the sample, the earliest hour consistent with the record. Tell: the option is dated by a record, and the record has a gap that the rule fills with the worst case. Last act that keeps it: a witness, someone awake, a time written on the vial, or a witness of another kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 returned the drug to patients with no witnessed onset. Changed next move: write the time on the label; keep the chain unbroken; where the record's clock has run, ask whether the tissue's clock can be read directly. Relation: not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run; here the body's clock may not have run at all and the record's has. Beside witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, this is the option that dies for want of a trace while the fact would still allow it.

Mooted by the world. Mechanism: the justiciability of a claim, a permission to be decided, ends because the situation resolves itself faster than the forum that would decide it can move; no one declines and no one rules. Carrier: a ratio, the forum's pace against the harm's duration, and no party at the table sets that number. Cases: the student whose challenge to a law school's admissions was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974); the pregnancy over before the appeal; the election held before the ballot-access case; the tenant evicted before the housing court sat; the employee whose grievance was mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post. Threshold: the moment the harm ends, wherever the forum then stands. Tell: the harm has a natural duration shorter than the docket. Last act that keeps it: a structure that outlives the individual harm, the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which is what Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, which is what Roe rested on. It is kept, when kept, by a coordination or by a rule and never by hurrying. Changed next move: build the structure, class or doctrine, at filing; do not race the harm. Relation: not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, since nothing is eaten on a curve, the harm is simply over. Not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date anywhere.

Session ends. Mechanism: the specific body whose yes was available, a counterparty, reaches the end of its term with the matter pending, and its successor starts the matter at zero without ever having to say no; what is lost is the matter's place in the process. Carrier: the ratifier's own calendar, election, session, or term. Cases: bills that die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from the beginning; the treaty signed and awaiting a parliament that was dissolved; the permit application before a council that was re-elected; the approval the old board agreed in the hallway and had not yet minuted when the board was reconstituted at the meeting; the offer approved by a committee disbanded in the reorganization. Threshold: adjournment, dissolution, the election, the reconstituting meeting. Tell: the yes lives in a body with a term, and the term is nearer than the vote. Last act that keeps it: the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway. Changed next move: read the ratifier's calendar before the matter's; get the minute. Caveat: the treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone; the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no. Relation: not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer; here it is replaced by the calendar. Beside deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain, stands the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote.

Landlord changes. Mechanism: an option held in a person rather than on the paper that transfers, so it ends at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder does not control and often does not see; the successor takes free of it. Carrier: the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, the paper on which the option was never written. Cases: the renewal promised by the landlord who sells the building to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises; the 'we'll take you back' from a manager who leaves; the side letter with a fund's partner that the fund's successor manager has never seen; the supplier's verbal priority that vanishes with the account executive. Threshold: the sale, the departure, the succession. Tell: the promise is good while the person stays, and it is nowhere on the instrument a successor reads. Last act that keeps it: recording, a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put on the paper that binds successors, at the cost of the awkwardness of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement. Changed next move: get every friendly promise onto the transferring paper while the friend is still there. Relation: not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes; here the shape stays and the counterparty goes. Beside term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have, stands its mirror, the replacement who declines to honour a term the friend gave.

Chair grown over. Mechanism: a capability on the counterparty's side, a vacancy nobody has yet re-planned; the option to return ends at the counterparty's next planning cycle without anyone declining the return. What is lost is the return to the seat; employment there afterwards is a new negotiation from the outside. Carrier: the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, which sets the expiry without reference to the holder at all. Cases: the leave taken with no return date whose post is redistributed among three people at the next reorganization; the budget line reallocated at year end; the supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed; the co-founder's seat that the remaining founders stop leaving empty at the next hire. Threshold: the next cycle. Tell: the absence is undated and the counterparty has a planning rhythm. Last act that keeps it: a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle has to respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns. Changed next move: date the absence before leaving; know the cycle and return inside it. Relation: no one opposes the return, which sets this beside traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant, where preparation for a future breeds its opponents; here the absence is simply absorbed. Not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way; this road closes.

Signatures expire. Mechanism: a coordination, a set of yeses that would be enough together, fails because the gathering does not outrun the decay of each yes; an option that requires many simultaneous assents has a half-life. Carrier: the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention. Cases: the recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or that must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days; the tender offer's minimum condition that has to be met by the offer's expiry; the crowd in the square that goes home; the reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time. Threshold: the window per assent, sixty days, a hundred and sixty days, the offer's expiry. Tell: the option needs many yeses at once and each yes has its own clock. Last act that keeps it: a gathering rate, paid circulators, a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives. Changed next move: set the gathering rate against the decay before starting; bind early assents. Caveat: the recall and tender cases are observed and the crowd is analogy. Relation: not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter; here many small calendars do. Beside who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving, stands the coordination lost by others' leaving.

Outgrew the buyer. Mechanism: a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity is the option, is moved out of reach by the holder's own growth; the option to sell to the natural acquirer ends at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all, a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling, with nobody at either table declining. Carrier: the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and its deal history, set against the holder's own price, which each round raises. Cases: the company whose preference stack comes to exceed the largest deal its three strategic buyers have ever done; the player whose wage outgrows every club in the league but two; the practice too large for any partner to buy in and too small to be listed. Threshold: the acquirer's ceiling, read from market value, largest prior deal, cap, or limit. Tell: each round raises the price and the buyer list gets shorter without anyone saying so. Last act that keeps it: the sale at the last price under the ceiling, which is never seen as the last, or a round sized to stay under it, which is the one choice a founder is never advised to make. Changed next move: before each round, list the natural acquirers and their ceilings, and check whether this round crosses one. Caveat: analytical, since every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more; it stands as a mechanism and not a count. Relation: not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans; here the counterparty is unchanged and the holder leaves its range. Beside market-deaths' Slowed past the rot, where a market thins from the outside, stands the market for the holder that the holder thinned by growing.

Pour the foundation. Mechanism: a permission about to be withdrawn by a third party's rule change can be kept only by an act in the world that no paper substitutes for; the option is preserved only by starting to use it. Carrier: the code and the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application, so the last act differs by jurisdiction and the holder who knows which has a different week. Cases: the building that can proceed under the old zoning only if the developer substantially began in reliance on a valid permit before the ordinance passed, the footings poured the week of the council vote; the nonconforming use that survives the new code only if it is in use on the effective date; the grandfathered rate kept only by the account that is open. Threshold: the ordinance's passage or effective date, against construction begun (or, in application-vesting states, a complete application). Tell: a rule change is on the docket and the permission has not been physically exercised. Last act that keeps it: the hole in the ground before the vote, an exercise begun rather than a filing made; one beginning vests it for good. Changed next move: find which act vests in this jurisdiction and do that act before the vote. Relation: not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated to keep the right; here one beginning vests. Beside first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose, stands the rule that changes for reasons of its own.

Slot flown empty. Mechanism: a permission that lives only while it is used ends by disuse; its clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the preserving act is the exercise emptied of its purpose. Carrier: the regulator's usage ledger. Cases: the airport slot that must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, which had airlines flying empty aircraft in early 2020 until the rule was waived; the water right under prior appropriation, forfeited after five years without beneficial use, which has fields irrigated in a drought to keep them; the trade mark abandoned after three years' non-use; the mining claim kept by annual labour; the department budget spent in the last quarter so that it is not cut. Threshold: eighty percent of the season; five years; three years; the annual labour; the fiscal year end. Tell: the right has a usage test and the ledger is kept by someone else. Last act that keeps it: the empty flight, which costs the whole price of using the option and returns nothing but the option, so keeping and using are the same act and the option's upkeep is its exercise price. Changed next move: budget the upkeep as an exercise price; decide whether the option is worth flying for nobody. Relation: not Pour the foundation, one act that vests; here no act ever finishes the keeping. Beside runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapses without hours logged and whose clock no cash extends, stands the price at which it can be extended after all, the hours flown for nobody. Beside tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp, stands the permission-holder who must burn the permission to keep it; beside power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved, stands the disuse that forfeits it by rule.

Thawed to be ready. Mechanism: the option to wait ends because the option to act was made ready; the good itself begins to spoil in its ready state, a decay the unprepared state does not have. Carrier: a chemistry, or a season, that begins at preparation. Cases: the vaccine vial that keeps for months frozen, weeks once thawed, and hours once punctured; the epoxy whose pot life begins at mixing; the drawn dose; the armed fuze; the reagent brought to room temperature; the opened surgical field; the reserve army that cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from. Threshold: months frozen, weeks thawed, hours punctured; the pot life; the harvest. Tell: readiness has its own shelf life shorter than the unready state's. Last act that keeps it: not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit, the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings; the clinic that thaws a tray to be sure of serving whoever comes buys its readiness with the doses it discards at closing. Changed next move: size the prepared unit to the demand you can see, and price readiness in discards. Relation: the mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched; here it dies of being touched, and a holder who holds both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other. Not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting, since the understudy does not spoil for having been rehearsed. Not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day; here it falls on the good.

Waived by the next step. Mechanism: a permission that has to be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is the holder's own next act and never a date; a holder who does nothing keeps it and a holder who does anything adjacent loses it. Carrier: a rule that binds the option to a position in a sequence, written in a different place than the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code, so the holder learns the order from the loss. Cases: the objection to the court's jurisdiction over the defendant, waived if left out of the first response; the patent dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States; the appeal waived by accepting the settlement; the election of remedies; the defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used; the 'speak now' at the wedding. Threshold: the first responsive pleading; the talk; the acceptance; the first use. Tell: you are about to act on a linked matter and have not checked whether some right must be raised first. Last act that keeps it: the ordering itself, the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the goods are unpacked, each costing nothing but the knowledge that an order exists. Changed next move: before any first move, ask what must be reserved in it. Relation: not Slot flown empty, where the holder's inaction runs the clock; here inaction is the only thing that keeps it. Not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date and the holder is the only one who can strike.

First write. Mechanism: the old state's ability to take over from here, a capability, lives exactly as long as the pause between the change and its first consequence; the option to reverse a move ends at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read, and closes without anyone deciding to close it. Carrier: the first write, performed by the new state in the ordinary course and not a decision about the reversal at all. Cases: the migration that can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects; the merger reversible until the first combined payroll; the new address reversible until the first piece of mail arrives there; the reorganization reversible until the first hire is made into the new chart; the currency changeover until the first contract is written in the new unit. Threshold: the first record, payroll, letter, hire, or contract the old state cannot read. Tell: the new state is live and about to do something ordinary. Last act that keeps it: the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so that the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth. Changed next move: before cutover, name the first unreadable write and decide whether to dual-write through it. Relation: not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good; here the new state's use closes the way back to the old. Beside pivot-invariants, which names the retained assets that make leaving cheap, stands the moment at which one of them is lost; beside undo-costs, which bills a reversal that remains possible, stands the reversal that stops being possible.

Kept on the machine. Mechanism: an eligibility, or a working, is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm, or whose lapse is one-way, so the deadline is the machine's and not the situation's. Carrier: the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill. Cases: the patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant who becomes ineligible for the transplant the machine is keeping her alive for, since bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit and centres set a duration beyond which candidacy is reviewed; the mothballed mine kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening; the ship in the reserve fleet whose hull is kept by cathodic protection that a budget line can end; the interim chief who has run the company past the point where the search can bring in an outsider. Threshold: the centre's duration limit on circuit; the budget line; the point past which the search cannot go outside. Tell: the thing keeping the option open is itself running a clock. Last act that keeps it: a listing at the moment of cannulation, a search begun the day the interim is named, a decision to stop pumping taken while a sale is still possible, each treating the bridge's start as the option's deadline. Changed next move: date the option from the day the bridge starts, not from the day the harm shows. Caveat: the ECMO limits are centre practice and are simplified. Relation: not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs; here the clock is a harm nobody signed. Beside lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour, stands the bridge that ends the option it holds open.

Standstill with a term. Mechanism: a pause taken to keep an option open is put on a paper with a date, so a situation that had no deadline acquires one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who now knows what the pause is worth to the holder; the holder wrote the clock. Carrier: the pause's own instrument, the only clock in the situation the holder wrote. Cases: the tolling agreement that stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing, and expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again; the negotiated leave of absence that dates a job which had no date and is extended only if the employer signs; the forbearance agreement that holds the lender's foreclosure for ninety days; the furlough whose recall rights run six months; the standstill in a takeover that keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says. Threshold: the term on the paper, twelve months, ninety days, six months. Tell: the pause has a date and someone else's signature is required to extend it. Last act that keeps it: the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, which is rarely granted; the Korean armistice is the exception that has no renewal date and is still called temporary. Changed next move: before signing a pause, ask whether you could have paused alone, and if not, ask for renewal early or for no term. Not this item: the statutory pauses, the twelve weeks of the family-leave statute and the restraining order's fourteen days, are the same date without the mechanism, since the term is a rule's and the renewal belongs to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it; those are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock. Not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search; here the search is stopped and the stopping is what expires. Beside impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip, stands the bill the chip carries.
B: Bank holiday by decree. Mechanism: an authority closes a whole class of exits, and the closure only works if nobody is told beforehand, because the telling would be the cue to run; so the door is locked in the hours the holder cannot reach it. Greece's banks stayed shut on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday-night broadcast. Cyprus declared a bank holiday in March 2013 and kept extending it, after parliament voted down the first levy, until the bail-in was on the statute book. Argentina's corralito was announced on a Saturday in December 2001. Export-licence suspensions and delistings are gazetted after they have taken effect. Condition lost: a permission, the leave to move what is yours. Carrier: the authority's own calendar, set to Friday evening and the public holiday. Threshold: the decree itself; there is no earlier line. Tell: this is the one expiry on the map whose notice cannot precede it, so a holder waiting for a date is waiting for something the mechanism forbids. Changed next move: the only preserving act was a transfer made on rumour alone, paid for by the chance of being wrong and the discount the rumour market charges; the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing firmer. Adds to runway-illusions' Cash behind glass (the deposit put into receivership on a Friday, owned and out of reach) the mechanism that picked the Friday. Not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse the founder can test by letting it burn, since a closure that can be probed need not arrive as a surprise; not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, which someone at the holder's table decides, since the decree rules on a class and nobody at the holder's table decided anything about the holder. No claim that the exit dies as a by-product: the decree names the exit and forbids it.

Bar date in the newspaper. Mechanism: the claim runs out on a date fixed in a proceeding the holder is not in the room for, and the law presumes the holder read it. The bankruptcy court sets a bar date for proofs of claim and notices unknown creditors by publication; the class settlement's opt-out deadline arrives on a postcard indistinguishable from junk mail; the probate creditor's window opens and shuts once the notice has run in the county paper. Condition lost: a permission, the standing to be paid or to sue on one's own account. Carrier: the bar-date order joined to the rule of constructive notice, under which publication counts as knowledge for everyone the debtor could not name. Threshold: the docket date, imputed to the holder. Tell: the holder who would file is, by definition, the one nobody told. Changed next move: a one-page proof of claim or a signed opt-out, the cheapest filing the law knows and the one least often made. Adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a permission whose date the holder can read on the stamp, the date written on someone else's docket and imputed to the holder. Not deal-deaths' Missing witness: nothing is missing from the record, only the holder from the room.

Parent instrument lapses. Mechanism: the option was issued under a parent paper with a term of its own, so it ends when the parent ends, on its own merits or none, and the grant itself prints no date. The emergency-use authorization ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a separate paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing; cross-state telehealth licences lapsed as each state's emergency lapsed through 2021 and 2022; the wartime power, the pilot run under a waiver, the sub-lease that dies with the head lease. Condition lost: a permission. Carrier: the parent instrument's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read. Threshold: the parent's termination, wherever that is written. Tell: the grant the holder did read carries no date, so the first job is to find which parent paper carries the term. Changed next move: conversion, filed while the parent still stands: full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in the holder's own name. Conversion is slow enough that it must be started while the emergency looks endless, which is exactly when nobody starts it. Not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date sits on a docket and is imputed, since here it sits on a different paper from the option and is honest; not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes, since here the rule does not wait but ends.

Patch before seven. Mechanism: the option expires on the holder's own developmental timetable, which the holder cannot know, so the last intervention is necessarily in someone else's hand. Amblyopia is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years of life and responds less, and less completely, after about seven, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens; the clubfoot is cast in infancy; the second language acquired without an accent, disputed as a hard window; the duckling imprinting on its first day. Condition lost: a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire. Carrier: the developmental schedule. Threshold: about seven for occlusion, with a tail into the early teens. Tell: the holder is a child who does not know there is an eye at stake, so the option belongs to one person and its preservation to another. Changed next move: screening, the preschool vision check and the parent who notices a squint; where no screening programme exists, the option expires unseen at a rate that belongs to the programme, not the child. Adds to Last known well, where a witness dates the option, the case in which the holder cannot be its own witness at all. Not a use-it-or-lose-it: nothing the child does or fails to do runs the clock.

Last known well. Mechanism: the option is dated by the last person who saw the fact, not by the fact, so it expires when the proof runs out while the tissue might still permit it. The stroke patient who wakes with the deficit is ineligible for thrombolysis because the four-and-a-half-hour window counts from when she was last seen well, which was bedtime, so the wake-up stroke loses the drug no matter when the artery actually closed; the same rule governs the opened vial with no time on the label and the sample with a gap in its chain of custody, both treated as expired at the earliest moment they could have been. Condition lost: a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids. Carrier: the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue. Threshold: the window counted from the last witnessed moment, not the actual onset. Tell: the record's clock has run when the body's may not have. Changed next move: a witness: someone awake, a time written on the vial, or a witness of another kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 gave the drug back to patients with no witnessed onset. Adds to witness-architectures, which asks what has to exist for a trace to form, the option that dies for lack of a trace while the fact would still allow it. Not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run.

Moot before ruling. Mechanism: the option to have a decision expires because the situation resolves faster than the forum can move, so nobody declines and nobody rules. The student's challenge to a law school's admissions was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974); the pregnancy is over before the appeal; the election is held before the ballot-access case; the tenant is evicted before housing court sits; the grievance is mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post. Condition lost: a permission, the justiciability of the claim. Carrier: the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number nobody at the table sets. Threshold: the harm ends before the forum reaches it. Tell: there is no date anywhere, and nothing is eaten along a curve; the harm is simply over. Changed next move: a structure that outlives the individual harm, never hurrying: the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review can be decided anyway, which Roe rested on; the option is kept by a coordination or a rule. Not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where the surplus is eaten along a curve; not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date.

Session ends. Mechanism: the body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter still pending, and its successor never has to say no, because the matter restarts from zero. Bills die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from scratch; the treaty is signed and waits on a parliament that is dissolved; the permit application sits before a council that is re-elected; the approval the old board agreed in the hallway and had not minuted when the board was reconstituted; the offer approved by a committee disbanded in the reorganization. Condition lost: a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was on offer; what expires is the matter's place in the process. Carrier: the ratifier's own calendar, its election, session, or term. Threshold: adjournment, dissolution, reconstitution. Tell: the successor starts the matter from zero with no recorded no. Changed next move: the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway. The treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone; the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand every session. Adds to deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain, the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote. Not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer, since here it is replaced by the calendar.

Landlord changes. Mechanism: an option held in a person rather than on the paper that transfers expires at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder neither controls nor, often, sees. The landlord who promised the renewal sells to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises; the 'we'll take you back' comes from a manager who leaves; the side letter with a fund's partner has never been seen by the successor manager; the supplier's verbal priority vanishes with the account executive. Condition lost: a counterparty, the one whose word held the option. Carrier: the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, none of which ever had the option written on it, so the successor takes free of it. Threshold: the transfer. Tell: the promise lives in a person, not on the instrument that binds successors. Changed next move: recording: a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put onto the paper that binds successors, at the cost of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement. Adds to term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have, the mirror case, in which the replacement declines to honour a term the friend gave. Tell: nobody opposes the return; the absence is simply absorbed. Changed next move: a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle has to respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns. Priced past the acquirer.
