Adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapses without hours logged and whose clock no cash extends, the price at which it can be extended after all: the hours flown for nobody. Adds to tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp, the permission-holder who must burn the permission to keep it; and to power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved, the disuse that forfeits it by rule. Not Pour the foundation, one act that vests.

Thawed to be ready. Mechanism: preparing to exercise the option starts a decay the unprepared state did not have, so the option to wait expires because the option to act was made ready. The vaccine vial keeps for months frozen, for weeks once thawed, for hours once punctured; the epoxy's pot life begins at mixing; the drawn dose; the armed fuze; the reagent brought to room temperature; the opened surgical field; the reserve army that cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from. Condition lost: a capability, the good itself, spoiling in its ready state. Carrier: a chemistry, or a season, that starts at preparation. Threshold: months frozen, weeks thawed, hours punctured; the pot life; the harvest. Tell: the harm falls on the good, not the holder; the option dies of being touched. Changed next move: not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit, the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings; the clinic that thaws a whole tray to be sure of serving whoever walks in has bought readiness with the doses it will throw away at closing. The mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched; a holder who holds both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other. Not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting, since the understudy does not spoil for having been rehearsed; not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day.

Waived by the first response. Mechanism: the option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is the holder's own next act rather than a date; a holder who does nothing keeps it, a holder who does anything adjacent loses it. The objection to the court's jurisdiction over the defendant is waived if omitted from the first response; the patent is dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States; the appeal is waived by taking the settlement; the election of remedies; the defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used; the 'speak now' at the wedding. Condition lost: a permission. Carrier: a rule that ties the option to a position in a sequence, and the sequence is written somewhere other than the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code. Threshold: the first adjacent move. Tell: the holder learns the order from the loss; there is no date, and the holder is the only one who can strike. Changed next move: the ordering itself: the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the goods are unpacked, each costing nothing but the knowledge that an order exists. Not Slot flown empty, where inaction runs the clock, since here inaction is the only thing that keeps it; not Bar date in the newspaper.

First write in the new shape. Mechanism: the option to reverse a move expires at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read, so the window is the pause between the change and its first consequence, and it closes with nobody deciding to close it. The migration can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects; the merger is reversible until the first combined payroll; the new address until the first piece of mail arrives; the reorganization until the first hire into the new chart; the currency changeover until the first contract written in the new unit. Condition lost: a capability, the old state's ability to take over from here. Carrier: the first write, performed by the new state in the ordinary course of business and not a decision about the reversal at all. Threshold: the first record the old shape rejects. Tell: the closing act is routine business in the new state, never a choice about going back. Changed next move: the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth. Adds to pivot-invariants, which name the retained assets that make leaving cheap, the moment one of them is lost; and to undo-costs, which bills a reversal that remains possible, the reversal that stops being possible. Not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good, since here the new state's use closes the way back to the old.

Kept on the machine. Mechanism: the option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm or whose stopping is one-way, so the deadline is the machine's and not the situation's. The patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant becomes ineligible for the transplant the circuit was keeping her alive for, because bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit and centres set a duration past which candidacy is reviewed; the mothballed mine kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening; the ship in the reserve fleet whose hull is kept by cathodic protection a budget line can end; the interim chief who has run the company past the point at which the search can bring in an outsider. Condition lost: a capability, the eligibility or the workings. Carrier: the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill. Threshold: the centre's duration limit, the budget line, the point past which the interim cannot be replaced by an outsider. Tell: the clock is a harm nobody signs, not a date. Changed next move: a listing at the moment of cannulation, a search begun the day the interim was named, a decision to stop pumping taken while a sale was still possible, each treating the bridge's start as the option's deadline. The ECMO limits are centre practice and are simplified. Adds to lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour, the bridge that ends the option it holds open. Not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs.

Standstill with a term. Mechanism: a pause taken to keep an option open is written on a paper that carries a date, so a situation that had no deadline acquires one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who now knows what the pause is worth to the holder. The tolling agreement stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing, and runs out in twelve months unless the adversary signs again; the negotiated leave of absence puts a date on a job that had none, extended only if the employer signs; the forbearance agreement holds the lender's foreclosure for ninety days; the furlough's recall rights run six months; the standstill in a takeover keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says. Condition lost: a permission, the leave to remain in the paused state. Carrier: the pause's own instrument, the only clock in the situation the holder wrote. Threshold: the twelfth month, the ninetieth day, the sixth month, the day the standstill says. Tell: the renewal belongs to the adversary, who has learned the pause's value. Changed next move: the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, rarely granted; the Korean armistice is the exception with no renewal date and is still called temporary. The statutory pauses, the twelve weeks of the family-leave statute and the restraining order's fourteen days, are the same date without the mechanism, since the term is a rule's and the renewal belongs to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it; those are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock. Adds to impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip, the bill the chip carries. Not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search, since here the search is stopped and the stopping is what expires.
C: Closure by decree in the hours you are shut out. Mechanism: an authority forbids a class of transactions by name, and the closure works only if nobody says it is coming, since the announcement would be the signal to leave; so it lands on a Friday night, a bank holiday, or a Sunday address, and by the time the holder can act the act is already forbidden. Condition lost: a permission, the leave to move what is yours. Carrier: the authority's calendar, laid deliberately over the hours the holder is locked out. Threshold: the decree itself; there is no date before it, because notice cannot come first. Tell: none from the authority. The only signal is rumour and the discount the rumour market charges; the deposits that left Greece in spring 2015 left on nothing better. Changed next move: transfer on rumour and pay the price of being wrong, or accept that waiting for a date is waiting for something the mechanism forbids. Cases: Greece, banks did not open Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday television speech; Cyprus, March 2013, a bank holiday stretched after parliament refused the first levy until the bail-in was law; Argentina's corralito announced on a Saturday in December 2001; an export licence suspended and a delisting published after the fact. Relations: runway-illusions' Cash behind glass counts the deposit taken into receivership on a Friday as owned and unreachable; this is the mechanism that chose the Friday. Not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse the founder can test by letting it pass; a closure you can probe is not one that must be a surprise. Not an offer withdrawn or a rival's foreclosure, which someone at your own table decides; the decree is an authority's rule on a class. The item stands on that fence alone, not on any claim that the exit dies as a side effect: the decree forbids the exit by name.

Bar date in the newspaper. Mechanism: the date is fixed in a proceeding the holder is not attending, and the law deems the holder to know it because it ran in a newspaper; constructive notice makes publication count as knowledge for every creditor the debtor could not name. Condition lost: a permission, the standing to be paid or to sue on your own. Carrier: the bar-date order married to the rule of constructive notice. Threshold: the bar date, the opt-out date, the probate creditor's window. Tell: a postcard that looks like advertising; a notice in the county paper; a claim you hold against a debtor in a proceeding you have not been served in. Changed next move: file the one-page proof of claim or the signed opt-out, the cheapest filing in the law and the one least often made, because the holder who would file it is by construction the one who was not told. Cases: the bankruptcy court's bar date for proofs of claim, noticed to unknown creditors by publication; the class settlement whose opt-out date arrives on a postcard; the probate creditor's window that opens and shuts with a notice in the county paper. Relations: runway-illusions' Stamp's clock is a permission with a date the holder can read on the stamp; this is that permission with its date on someone else's docket and imputed to you. Not deal-deaths' Missing witness; nothing is missing from the record, only the holder from the room.

Grant with the date on the parent paper. Mechanism: a grant with no date on its face runs on the term of the parent instrument it was issued under, and when the parent's term ends the grant ends with it, whatever its own merits. Condition lost: a permission. Carrier: the parent instrument's date. Threshold: termination of the parent instrument, which may be a different paper from the one everyone is watching. Tell: the grant you hold has no date on it. First act: identify which parent paper carries the date, since the grant you read carried none. Changed next move: conversion filed while the parent still stands, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in your own name; conversion is slow enough that it must be started while the emergency looks endless, the season in which nobody starts it. Cases: the emergency-use authorization that ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing; the cross-state telehealth licence that lapsed with each state's emergency through 2021 and 2022; the wartime power; the pilot run under a waiver; the sub-lease that dies with the head lease. Relations: not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date sits on a docket and is imputed to you; here the date is on a different paper than the option and is honest. Not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes; here the rule does not wait, it ends.

Patch before seven. Mechanism: the holder is a child who does not know she has an option, and the clock is her own cortex on a developmental timetable that neither she nor anyone outside can read with precision. Condition lost: a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire. Carrier: the developmental timetable. Threshold: amblyopia is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years and responds less, and less completely, after about seven; trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens. Tell: a squint a parent notices; a preschool vision check; and at the population level, the absence of a screening programme, since where none exists the option expires unseen at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of the child. Changed next move: screening. The option belongs to one person and its preservation to another; the intervention is institutional, made by people the child will never meet. Cases: amblyopia patching; the clubfoot cast in infancy; the second language spoken without an accent, contested as a hard window; the duckling that imprints in its first day. Relations: Last known well has a witness dating the option; this is the case where the holder cannot be her own witness at all. Not a use-it-or-lose-it; nothing the child does or leaves undone runs the clock.

Last known well. Mechanism: the protocol does not ask the tissue when the artery closed; it asks who saw you last, and dates the option from the last witness, so the option dies for want of a record while the fact would still allow it. Condition lost: a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids. Carrier: the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue. Threshold: the four-and-a-half-hour thrombolysis window counted from last seen well; for the wake-up stroke that is bedtime, so the drug is lost regardless of when the artery closed. The same rule dates the opened vial with no time on the label and the sample with a gap in its chain of custody: expired at the earliest moment they could have been. Tell: a deficit present on waking; a label with no time; a custody gap. Changed next move: supply a witness. Someone awake; a time written on the vial at opening; or a witness of a different kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 returned the drug to patients with no witnessed onset. Relations: witness-architectures asks what must exist for a trace to form; this is the option that dies for want of a trace. Not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run; here the body's clock may not have run, and the record's has.

Mooted before the forum sits. Mechanism: the situation resolves itself faster than the forum moves, so nobody declines and nobody rules; the claim is dismissed as moot with neither a yes nor a no. Condition lost: a permission, the justiciability of the claim. Carrier: a ratio, the forum's pace over the harm's duration, and no party at the table sets either term. Threshold: the moment the harm ends before judgment. Tell: a graduation date, a due date, an election date, an eviction, or a reorganization that abolishes the post, each closer than the docket. Changed next move: build a structure that outlives the individual harm before the harm ends: the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which is what Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, which is what Roe rested on. The option is kept by a coordination or by a rule, never by hurrying. Cases: the student whose challenge to a law school's admissions was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate, DeFunis (1974); the pregnancy over before the appeal; the election held before the ballot-access case; the tenant evicted before the housing court sits; the employee whose grievance is mooted by the reorganization. Relations: not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where the surplus is eaten on a curve; here nothing is eaten and the harm is simply over. Not Bar date in the newspaper; there is no date anywhere.

Session ends. Mechanism: the ratifying body's term ends with your matter pending; the body that could have said yes is gone, and its successor never has to say no because it starts you from zero. Condition lost: a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available; what expires is your place in the process. Carrier: the ratifier's own calendar, its election, its session, its term. Threshold: adjournment sine die, dissolution, the re-election, the reconstitution of the board. Tell: an approval agreed in the hallway and not yet minuted; a matter pending as the session's end approaches; a committee scheduled for reorganization. Changed next move: the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway. Cases: bills that die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from the beginning, by the thousand each session with no recorded no; the treaty signed and waiting on a parliament that is dissolved; the permit application before a council that is re-elected; the offer approved by a committee disbanded in the reorganization. Caveat on the treaty cases: most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone, so the clean form is the legislative bill. Relations: deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal has a ratifier that wanted a different bargain; this is the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote. Not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by a transfer; here it is replaced by the calendar.

Landlord changes. Mechanism: the promise attaches to the person who made it, not to the thing it is about, and that person can be sold out from under you, leave, or be succeeded, often without your seeing it; the successor takes free of anything not written on the paper that transfers. Condition lost: a counterparty, the one whose word held the option. Carrier: the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, the paper that transfers, on which the option was never written. Threshold: the sale, the departure, the succession. Tell: the option exists only in a verbal or unrecorded promise from a friendly counterparty you have not asked to bind their unknown replacement. Changed next move: recording. A memorandum of option on the title; a side letter countersigned by the entity; the promise moved onto the paper that binds successors, at the price of the awkwardness of asking. Cases: the renewal promised by the landlord who sells the building to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises; the 'we'll take you back' from a manager who leaves; the side letter with a fund's partner that the successor manager has never seen; the supplier's verbal priority that vanishes with the account executive. Relations: term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair has the replacement exercising a term the friend would not have; this is its mirror, the replacement declining to honour a term the friend gave. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.

Chair grown over. Mechanism: a seat you left is a vacancy, and a vacancy is only a thing the counterparty has not yet re-planned; at the next planning cycle it is re-planned, and no one declines your return because no one is asked. Condition lost: a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could receive you; what expires is the return to the seat, and employment there afterwards is a new negotiation from the outside. Carrier: the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, which sets the expiry without reference to you. Threshold: the next cycle. Tell: a leave with no return date; a budget line approaching year end; a seat left empty as the next hire is planned. Changed next move: a dated return; a leave rather than a resignation; a reservation the cycle must respect; or the return itself before the cycle turns. Cases: the leave taken with no return date whose post is redistributed among three people at the next reorganization; the budget line reallocated at year end; the supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed; the co-founder's seat the remaining founders stop leaving empty at the next hire. Relations: traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant has preparation for a future breeding its opponents; here no one opposes the return and the absence is simply absorbed. Not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way; this road has closed.

Yeses with a half-life. Mechanism: each yes decays from the moment it is signed, so an option that needs many yeses at once expires unless the gathering outruns the rot of what has already been gathered. Condition lost: a coordination. Carrier: the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention. Threshold: the window itself. Michigan invalidates recall signatures older than sixty days; California requires all to fall within a hundred and sixty days; a tender offer's minimum condition must be met by the offer's expiry. Tell: early signatures aging out faster than late ones arrive; a minimum condition still unmet as the expiry approaches. Changed next move: a gathering rate, paid circulators; a date agreed in advance; a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives. Cases: the recall petition; the tender offer's minimum condition; the crowd in the square that goes home; the reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time. Evidence: the recall and tender cases are observed; the crowd is analogy. Relations: who-can-be-bound's Place in line is an ordering lost by your leaving; this is the coordination lost by others' leaving. Not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter; here many small calendars do, and none of them is the one you were watching.

Priced past the buyer. Mechanism: every round that raises your price moves the natural buyer further out of reach, until the round that prices you above what the acquirer can pay at all, with nobody at either table declining anything. Condition lost: a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option. Carrier: the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and its deal history, set against your own price, which each round raises. Threshold: a market capitalization smaller than the price; a wage cap; a fund's concentration limit; past those, a board's approval ceiling. Tell: a preference stack that now exceeds the largest deal your three strategic buyers have ever done; a wage that outgrows every club in the league but two; a practice too large for any partner to buy in and too small to be listed. Changed next move: the sale at the last price under the ceiling, which is never seen as the last, or a round sized to stay under it, the one choice a founder is never advised to make. Evidence: analytical, not a count, since every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more. Relations: market-deaths' Slowed past the rot has a market thinning from the outside; this is the market for you that you thin by growing. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans; here the counterparty is unchanged and you have left its range.

Pour the foundation. Mechanism: the ground under a permit is rewritten by a third party's rule change, and no paper you can file will keep it; only an act in the world will. Condition lost: a permission. Carrier: the code and the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application. Threshold: the ordinance's passage or effective date; the last act that vests differs by jurisdiction, so the holder who knows which has a different week. Tell: a council vote scheduled; a new code with an effective date; a grandfathered rate kept only by an open account. Changed next move: the hole in the ground before the vote, an exercise begun rather than a filing made; check whether your jurisdiction vests on construction or on application, and act on that week. Cases: the building that may proceed under the old zoning only if substantially begun in reliance on a valid permit before the ordinance passes; the footings poured the week of the council vote; the nonconforming use that survives the new code only if in use on the effective date; the grandfathered rate. Relations: first-mover-forecloses holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose; this is the rule that changes for reasons of its own. Not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated to keep the right; here one beginning vests it for good.

Tell: a usage percentage or a years-without-use rule on the permission; a budget line that shrinks to last year's spend. Relations: impasse-inventions' cooling-off right offers reversibility as a chip; this is the bill the chip carries. Not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search; here the search is stopped, and the stopping is what expires.
D: Weekend closure. Mechanism: an authority shuts the exit in the hours the holder cannot act, because the announcement of the closure would itself be the signal to use it, so the notice cannot come first. Greek banks, Monday 29 June 2015, after a Sunday address. Cyprus, March 2013, a bank holiday extended after parliament refused the first levy, until the bail-in was law. Argentina's corralito, a Saturday in December 2001. An export licence suspended, a delisting published, after the fact. Lost: permission, the leave to move what is yours. Carrier: the authority's calendar, set to the holder's shut hours, Friday night, the bank holiday, the Sunday decree. Threshold: the decree itself; the Friday deposit is already on the wrong side of it when the Sunday address is given. Tell: none in advance, by construction. The only signal is rumour, and the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing more. Changed next move: do not wait for a date, because a date is what the mechanism forbids. If the exit is to be used, use it on rumour, paying the rumour discount and the cost of being wrong. Beside runway-illusions' Cash behind glass, which counts the Friday deposit as owned and unreachable: this is what chose the Friday. Not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse the founder tests by letting it pass; what can be probed need not surprise. Not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, which are decided at the holder's table. A decree rules a class, and nobody at the table decided about the holder. The exit is forbidden by name, not lost as a side effect.

Bar date in the newspaper. Mechanism: the claim ends on a date set in a proceeding the holder does not attend and is deemed to have read. The bankruptcy bar date for proofs of claim, noticed to unknown creditors by publication. The class opt-out date on a postcard that looks like advertising. The probate creditor's window after the notice runs in the county paper. Lost: permission, the standing to be paid or to sue alone. Carrier: the bar-date order and the rule of constructive notice; publication is knowledge for anyone the debtor could not name. Threshold: the bar date on the order, imputed to the holder whether or not the paper was opened. Tell: the postcard that looks like advertising, the legal notice in the county paper; the holder who would need the tell is by construction the one not told. Changed next move: file the one-page proof of claim or sign the opt-out. It is the cheapest filing in the law and the least made. Beside runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a date the holder can read on the stamp: this date is on another's docket and imputed. Not deal-deaths' Missing witness; the record is whole, and only the holder is missing from the room.

Emergency over. Mechanism: the option was granted under a parent instrument with a term of its own, and it ends when the parent ends, on no date of its own, whatever its merits. The emergency-use authorization, ended when the declaration it was issued under is terminated; a different paper from the public-health emergency, which ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing. The cross-state telehealth licence, lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022. The wartime power. The pilot under a waiver. The sub-lease under the head lease. Lost: permission. Carrier: the parent's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read, since the grant it read carried none. Threshold: the parent's termination, on the parent's paper. Tell: the grant in hand shows no date; that absence is the tell, and the holder's first job is to find which paper carries the date. Changed next move: convert while the parent stands. A full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in one's own name. Conversion is slow, so it must start while the emergency looks endless, which is when nobody starts it. Not Bar date in the newspaper: that date is on a docket and imputed; this one is on another paper, and honest. Not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes; this rule does not wait. It ends.

Patch before seven. Mechanism: the option ends by the holder's own development, on a schedule the holder cannot know, so the last keep is in another hand. Amblyopia, most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years, less and less completely after about seven, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens. The clubfoot cast in infancy. The second language without an accent, contested as a hard window. The duckling's first day. Lost: a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire. Carrier: the developmental timetable; the holder is a child who does not know there is an eye to save. Threshold: about seven for the patch, soft at the edges, and not printed anywhere the holder can read. Tell: a squint a parent notices, a failed preschool vision check; nothing the child itself can report. Changed next move: screen. Put the preschool vision check in place, because the option is one person's and its preservation is another's. Where no programme exists, the option expires unseen at a rate that belongs to the programme, not to the child. Beside Last known well, where a witness dates the option: here the holder cannot be its own witness at all. Not use-it-or-lose-it; nothing the child does or leaves undone runs the clock.

Last known well. Mechanism: the option is dated by the last witness to the fact, not by the fact, and it ends when the proof runs out while the body might still allow it. The stroke patient who wakes with the deficit is ineligible for thrombolysis, because the four and a half hours count from when she was last seen well, at bedtime, whenever the artery closed. The opened vial with no time on the label. The sample with a gap in its chain of custody. Each is treated as expired at the earliest time it could have been. Lost: a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids. Carrier: the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness, not for the tissue. Threshold: four and a half hours from the last witnessed well time, not from onset. Tell: the gap itself. A patient found rather than seen, a label without a time, a custody log with a hole. Changed next move: supply a witness. Someone awake. A time written on the vial at opening. Or a witness of another kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 returned the drug to patients with no witnessed onset. Beside witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form: the option that dies for want of a trace while the fact would still allow it. Not Patch before seven, where the body's clock has run; here the body's may not have, and the record's has.

Mooted. Mechanism: the option to a decision ends because the situation resolves faster than the forum moves. Nobody declines. Nobody rules. The student whose admissions challenge was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974). The pregnancy over before the appeal. The election held before the ballot-access case. The tenant evicted before housing court sits. The grievance mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post. Lost: permission, the justiciability of the claim. Carrier: the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration; no party at the table sets it. Threshold: the day the harm ends, whenever the docket says the hearing is. Tell: a harm whose natural duration is shorter than the forum's calendar, a graduation date, a term of pregnancy, an election day, already set when the case is filed. Changed next move: build a structure that outlives the individual harm rather than hurrying. The class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which Sosna (1975) allowed. The doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, which Roe rested on. The option is kept by a coordination or a rule, never by pace. Not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where surplus is eaten on a curve; nothing is eaten, the harm is over. Not Bar date in the newspaper; there is no date anywhere.

Session ends. Mechanism: the body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter pending, and its successor never has to say no. Bills that die on adjournment sine die and start again from the beginning. The treaty signed, awaiting a parliament that is dissolved. The permit before a council that is re-elected. The approval agreed in the hallway and not yet minuted when the board was reconstituted at the meeting. The offer approved by a committee disbanded in the reorganization. What ends is the matter's place in the process; the successor starts it at zero. Lost: a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available. Carrier: the ratifier's own calendar, its election, session, or term. Threshold: adjournment sine die, the dissolution, the reconstitution of the board; the matter's position in the queue is what dies at that line. Tell: a yes given in the hallway with the vote still unscheduled, and a session or term with a known end. Changed next move: get the vote scheduled before adjournment, move the carry-over motion, have the approval minuted rather than agreed in passing. The treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone; the clean form is the bill, dying by the thousand each session with no recorded no. Beside deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain: this ratifier wanted this one and was gone before the vote. Not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer; here it is replaced by the calendar.

Landlord changes. Mechanism: an option held in a person, not on the paper that transfers, ends at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder does not control and often does not see. The renewal promised by the landlord who sells the building to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises. The 'we'll take you back' from a manager who leaves. The side letter with a fund's partner that the successor manager has never seen. The supplier's verbal priority, gone with the account executive. Lost: a counterparty, the one whose word held the option. Carrier: the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead; the option was never written there, so the successor takes free of it. Threshold: the transfer, the sale closing, the manager's last day, the change of fund manager. Tell: a promise that lives in a person and appears on no instrument that binds their replacement. Changed next move: record it. A memorandum of option on the title. A side letter countersigned by the entity. The promise put on the paper that binds successors. The cost is the awkwardness of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement. Beside term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have: the mirror, where the replacement declines a term the friend gave. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.

Chair grown over. Mechanism: the option to return rests on a vacancy the counterparty has not yet re-planned, and it ends at the next planning cycle, with nobody declining the return. The leave with no return date whose post is split among three at the next reorganization. The budget line reallocated at year end. The supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed. The co-founder's seat the remaining founders stop leaving empty at the next hire. What ends is the return to the seat; employment there afterwards is a new negotiation from outside. Lost: a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could receive the holder. Carrier: the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, set without reference to the holder at all. Threshold: the cycle's turn, year end, the reorganization, the next hire. Tell: an open-ended absence with no dated return on anyone's plan, sitting across a planning cycle the holder does not attend. Changed next move: date the return. Take a leave rather than a resignation. Lodge a reservation the cycle must respect. Or return before the cycle turns. Beside traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant, where preparation for a future breeds its opponents: here nobody opposes the return; the absence is absorbed. Not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way; this road has closed.

Petition that goes stale. Mechanism: an option that needs many simultaneous yeses ends unless the gathering outruns the decay of each yes. A coordination has a half-life. The recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days. The tender offer's minimum condition, to be met by the offer's expiry. The crowd in the square that goes home. The reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time. Lost: a coordination. Carrier: the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention. Threshold: the point at which the oldest yes expires before the last yes arrives, sixty days in Michigan, a hundred and sixty in California, the offer's expiry for the tender. Tell: a gathering rate slower than the decay rate of the yeses already in hand. Changed next move: raise the gathering rate. Paid circulators. A date agreed in advance. A pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives. The recall and tender cases are observed; the crowd is analogy. Beside who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving: here the coordination is lost by others' leaving. Not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter; here many small calendars do.

Outgrown the buyer. Mechanism: the holder's own growth moves the counterparty out of reach. The option to sell to the natural acquirer ends at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all: a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling. Nobody at either table declines. The company whose preference stack now exceeds the largest deal its three strategic buyers have ever done. The player whose wage outgrows every club in the league but two. The practice too large for any partner to buy in and too small to be listed. Lost: a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option. Carrier: the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and its deal history, against the holder's own price, which each round raises. Threshold: the round whose price crosses the acquirer's ceiling, market value, wage cap, concentration limit, approval ceiling. Tell: a preference stack or valuation approaching the largest deal the natural buyers have ever done, read off their public market value and deal history. Changed next move: sell at the last price under the ceiling, which is never seen as the last. Or size the round to stay under it, the one choice a founder is never advised to make. Analytical: every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more, so this stands as a mechanism, not a count. Beside market-deaths' Slowed past the rot, where a market thins from outside: here the holder thins its own market by growing. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans; the counterparty is unchanged, and the holder has left its range.

Pour the foundation. Mechanism: a permission is about to be withdrawn by a third party's rule change, and it can be kept only by an act in the world; no paper substitutes. The building that may proceed under the old zoning only if the developer has substantially begun on a valid permit before the ordinance passes, the footings poured the week of the council vote. The nonconforming use that survives the new code only if in use on the effective date. The grandfathered rate kept only by the account that was open. Lost: permission. Carrier: the code and the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application. Threshold: the ordinance's passage or the code's effective date, against which the vesting act must already be done. Tell: a rule change on a council's agenda while the holder's permit is valid but unexercised; and which act vests differs by jurisdiction, so the holder who knows which has a different week. Changed next move: the hole in the ground before the vote. An exercise begun, not a filing made, unless the jurisdiction is one where the complete application vests. The option is preserved only by starting to use it. Beside first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose: here the rule changes for reasons of its own. Not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated to keep the right; here one beginning vests it for good.

Slot flown empty. Mechanism: the permission ends by disuse and is kept only by exercise. The clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the preserving act is the exercise emptied of its purpose. The airport slot that must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, which had airlines flying empty aircraft in early 2020 until the rule was waived. The water right under prior appropriation, forfeited after five years without beneficial use, which has fields irrigated in a drought to keep them. The trade mark abandoned after three years' non-use. The mining claim kept by annual labour. The department budget spent in the last quarter so it is not cut. Lost: permission. Carrier: the regulator's usage ledger. Threshold: the ledger's line, eighty percent of the season's slots, five years without beneficial use, three years' non-use, the annual labour, the fiscal year end. Tell: a usage ledger the holder is falling short of while the underlying purpose has gone. Changed next move: fly the empty flight. It costs the whole price of using the option and returns nothing but the option. Keeping and using are one act; the option's upkeep is its exercise price. Beside runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a licence that lapses without hours logged and that no cash extends: the price at which it can be extended after all, hours flown for nobody. Beside tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp: the holder who must burn the permission to keep it. Beside power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved: the disuse that forfeits it by rule. Not Pour the foundation, one act that vests; here no act ever finishes the keeping.

Thawed to be ready. Mechanism: preparing to exercise starts a decay the unprepared state did not have. The option to wait ends because the option to act was made ready. The vaccine vial: months frozen, weeks thawed, hours punctured. The epoxy whose pot life begins at mixing. The drawn dose. The armed fuze. The reagent brought to room temperature. The opened surgical field. The reserve army that cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from. Lost: a capability, the good itself spoiling in its ready state. Carrier: a chemistry, or a season, that begins at preparation. Threshold: the ready state's own shelf life, weeks for the thawed vial, hours once punctured, the pot life, the harvest. Tell: the act of readying itself, the thaw, the mix, the draw, the arming; each starts a clock the frozen state did not carry. Changed next move: do not prepare, or prepare in the smallest unit. The single-dose vial. The small mix. The tranche thawed for the day's bookings. The clinic that thaws a tray to be sure of serving whoever comes has bought readiness with the doses it will discard at closing. The mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched; here it dies of being touched. A holder of both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other. Not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting; the understudy does not spoil for having been rehearsed. Not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day; here it falls on the good.

First or never. Mechanism: the option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter. Its clock is the holder's own next act, not a date. Do nothing and keep it; do anything adjacent and lose it. The objection to the court's jurisdiction over the defendant, waived if left out of the first response. The patent dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States. The appeal waived by accepting the settlement. The election of remedies. The defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used. 'Speak now' at the wedding. Lost: permission. Carrier: a rule that binds the option to a position in a sequence. The sequence is written elsewhere than the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code, so the holder learns the order from the loss. Threshold: the first responsive pleading, the first public disclosure, the acceptance of the settlement, the first use of the goods. Tell: an adjacent move about to be made, a first filing, a talk, a signature, on a matter the option is linked to by a rule the holder has not read. Changed next move: the ordering itself. The provisional application filed the morning of the talk. The reservation written into the first filing. The objection lodged before the goods are unpacked. Each costs nothing but the knowledge that an order exists. Not Slot flown empty, where the holder's inaction runs the clock; here inaction is the only thing that keeps it. Not Bar date in the newspaper; there is no date, and only the holder can strike.

Rollback horizon. Mechanism: the option to reverse a move ends at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read. The window is the pause between the change and its first consequence, and it closes with nobody deciding to close it. The migration that can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects. The merger, until the first combined payroll. The new address, until the first piece of mail arrives there. The reorganization, until the first hire into the new chart. The currency changeover, until the first contract in the new unit. Lost: a capability, the old state's ability to take over from here. Carrier: the first write, performed by the new state in the ordinary course; not a decision about the reversal at all. Threshold: the first record, payroll, letter, hire, or contract in the new shape. Tell: a cutover done with the old state still standing and no one watching for the first write that will strand it. Changed next move: the expand-and-contract shape. Write to both for a season so the old can still read. The price is running two, and a season in which neither is the truth. Beside pivot-invariants, which name the retained assets that make leaving cheap: the moment one of them is lost. Beside undo-costs, which bills a reversal that remains possible: the reversal that stops being possible. Not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good; here the new state's use closes the way back to the old.

Kept on the machine. Mechanism: the option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm, or whose lapse is one-way. The deadline is the machine's, not the situation's. The patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant who becomes ineligible for the transplant the machine was keeping her alive for: bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit, and centres set a duration beyond which candidacy is reviewed. The mothballed mine kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening. The ship in the reserve fleet whose hull is kept by cathodic protection that a budget line can end. The interim chief who has run the company past the point where the search can bring in an outsider. Lost: a capability, the eligibility or the workings. Carrier: the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill. Threshold: the centre's duration limit on circuit, the budget line's end, the point past which the interim cannot be replaced from outside. Tell: a bridge started without the thing it bridges to being listed, searched for, or scheduled; each week on the bridge is the tell. Changed next move: treat the bridge's start as the option's deadline. A listing at the moment of cannulation. A search begun the day the interim was named. A decision to stop pumping taken while a sale was still possible. The ECMO limits are centre practice, simplified. Beside lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour: the bridge that ends the option it holds open. Not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs; here the clock is a harm nobody signs.

Standstill with a term. Mechanism: a pause taken to keep an option open is written on a paper with a date, so a situation that had no deadline acquires one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who now knows what the pause is worth to the holder. The tolling agreement that stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing, and that expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again. The negotiated leave that dates a job which had no date, extended only if the employer signs. The forbearance that holds the lender's foreclosure for ninety days. The furlough whose recall rights run six months. The takeover standstill that keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says. Lost: permission, the leave to remain in the paused state. Carrier: the pause's own instrument, the only clock in the situation the holder wrote. Threshold: the paper's date, twelve months, ninety days, six months, the day the standstill says. Tell: a pause whose renewal line is signed by the adversary, and an adversary who has learned from the first signing what the pause is worth. Changed next move: ask for the renewal before the counterparty learns it is needed. Or write the pause without a term, rarely granted; the Korean armistice has no renewal date and is still called temporary. The statutory pauses, the family-leave statute's twelve weeks and the restraining order's fourteen days, are the same date without the mechanism: the term is a rule's, the renewal belongs to a court or to no one, and the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it. Those are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock. Beside impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip: the bill the chip carries. Not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search; here the search is stopped, and the stopping is what expires.
E: Bank holiday. A permission to move what is yours (deposits, exports, a listing) is withdrawn by a rule on a whole class, and the announcement comes after the doors have already shut, because a closure of this kind works only if nobody is told; advance notice would be the starting gun. Lost: a permission, the leave to move your own assets. Carrier: the authority's calendar, laid deliberately against the holder's locked hours: the Sunday speech, the Friday night, the holiday already on the calendar. Cases: Greece, June 2015, a Sunday address and banks not open Monday the 29th; Cyprus, March 2013, a bank holiday extended day by day while parliament refused the first levy, ended only once the bail-in was law; Argentina, told on a Saturday in December 2001; the export licence suspended and the delisting published after the fact, in the same tense. Threshold: the doors shut in hours you cannot reach them; the announcement describes a thing already done. Tell: an address scheduled for Sunday with nothing said about the banks. Of every expiry on this map this is the one whose notice cannot come first, so the small signs are all there is; a holder waiting for a date is waiting for what the mechanism forbids. Changed move: act on rumour, weeks early, paying the rumour market's discount and the price of being wrong; the money that left Greece that spring left on nothing firmer. Neighbours: runway-illusions' Cash behind glass is the same event from the deposit's side (owned, unreachable, behind glass on a Friday); this item is what chose the Friday. Not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse you can test by letting it pass: anything that can be probed is not this. Not an offer withdrawn or a rival's foreclosure, which someone at your own table decides; this is a rule on a class and nobody at your table was asked. Not a side effect of some other act: the decree names the exit and forbids it.

Bar date in the newspaper. A proceeding you are not attending fixes a date, and constructive notice deems you to have read it: a line in a newspaper, a postcard that looks like advertising. Lost: a permission, the standing to be paid or to sue on your own account. Carrier: the bar-date order together with the rule of constructive notice, under which publication counts as your knowledge. Cases: the bankruptcy court's bar date for proofs of claim, noticed by publication for the creditors the debtor could not name; the class settlement's opt-out date printed on a postcard; the probate creditor's window, opening the day the notice runs in the county paper and closing on schedule. Threshold: the printed date passes. Tell: the postcard that looks like advertising, built to be missed; by construction the person who would file is the person who was not told. Changed move: a one-page proof of claim, a signed opt-out, the cheapest filing in the law and the one least often made. Read the mail you are about to throw away and read the legal notices; the date is on someone else's docket and is being written against you. Neighbours: runway-illusions' Stamp's clock is the near case, a permission with a date you can read on the stamp; here the date is written elsewhere and imputed to you. Not deal-deaths' Missing witness: the record is complete, and nothing is missing from it but you from the room.

Emergency authorization. A grant with no date of its own ends when the instrument it was issued under ends. Lost: a permission. Carrier: the parent instrument's date, which you never signed and may never have read; the first job is to find which paper is the parent, since the one you hold has no date to find. Cases: the emergency-use authorization, which ends when its declaration is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing; cross-state telehealth licences, which went with each state's emergency, one state at a time, in 2021 and 2022; the wartime power, the pilot programme run under a waiver, the sub-lease under a head lease. Threshold: the parent's termination. Tell: the grant in hand has no date, and the emergency looks endless; the stillness is the sign. Changed move: conversion (a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in your own name) filed while the parent still stands. Conversion is slow enough that it must begin while the emergency looks endless, which is precisely when nobody begins it. Neighbours: not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date sits on a docket and is imputed to you; here the date is honest, only it is on a different paper from your option. Not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes; this rule does not wait, it ends.

Patch before seven. The holder's own development runs the clock, on a schedule the holder cannot read and nobody reads exactly, and because the holder is a child the last intervention is necessarily in another hand. Lost: a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire. Carrier: the developmental timetable. Cases: amblyopia, most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years; after about seven it responds less and less completely, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens, so the edge is soft and still an edge; clubfoot cast in infancy; the second language spoken without an accent, claimed as a window and disputed as a hard one; the duckling imprinting on its first day. Threshold: soft, around age seven for patching. Tell: not in the child, who does not know there is an eye to save, but in whether anybody is looking; the squint glanced at and forgotten. Changed move: the preschool vision check, the parent who looks twice at the squint. Where no screening programme exists the option expires unseen, at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of any child. Neighbours: sits beside Last known well, where a witness dates the option; here the holder cannot be its own witness at all. Not a use-it-or-lose-it: nothing the child does or leaves undone moves the clock.

Last known well. The protocol dates the event by the last witness, not by the tissue; anything without a witnessed time is treated as expired at the earliest hour it could have been. Lost: a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids. Carrier: the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue. Cases: the four-and-a-half-hour thrombolysis window counted from bedtime, so the wake-up stroke loses the drug no matter when the vessel closed; the opened vial with no time on the label; the sample whose chain of custody has a gap. Threshold: four and a half hours from the last witnessed well time. Tell: the gap in the record; watch for it before you watch for the harm. The body may still allow what the paper no longer will. Changed move: a witness (someone awake, a time written on the vial), or a witness of a different kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, which is how the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 gave the drug back to patients with no seen onset. Neighbours: belongs beside witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form; here is the option that dies for want of a trace while the fact would still permit it. Not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run; here the body's clock may not have run, and the record's has.

Moot before heard. The forum's calendar is longer than the harm's duration, so the harm ends before the ruling and the claim stops being justiciable; nobody declines it and nobody rules. Lost: a permission, the justiciability of the claim. Carrier: the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number no one at the table sets. Threshold: the harm ends before the ruling. Tell: lay the court's calendar against the calendar of the harm; when the second is shorter, the sign is already there. Changed move: a structure that outlives the one harm, the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends (Sosna, 1975), or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, on which Roe rested. The option is kept by a coordination or by a rule, never by hurrying; hurrying is the reflex and the wrong reading of the sign. Neighbours: not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where a surplus is eaten along a curve; nothing is eaten here, the harm is simply over. Session ends. The body whose yes was available reaches the end of its own term with the matter still pending; the body that follows starts from nothing and never has to say no. Lost: a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available; what expires is the matter's place in the process, since the successor starts it at zero. Carrier: the ratifier's own calendar, its election, its session, its term. Cases: bills die on adjournment sine die by the thousand each session, without a recorded no, and must be reintroduced from the beginning; the treaty signed and waiting for a parliament that is dissolved; the permit application before a council that is re-elected; the old board's hallway agreement, unminuted when the board was reconstituted at the meeting; the committee that approved the offer, disbanded in the reorganization. The treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were in the end refused by someone; the clean form is the bill. Threshold: adjournment, dissolution, reconstitution. Tell: nobody has spoken against it and the calendar is running out. Changed move: the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway. Neighbours: sits beside deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain; here the ratifier wanted this one and was gone before the vote. Landlord changes. An option held in a person rather than on the paper that transfers expires at the counterparty's next transfer; the successor takes title free of unrecorded promises. Lost: a counterparty, the one whose word held the option. Carrier: the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, the paper on which the option was never written. Cases: the renewal promised across a desk and not in the lease, and the building sold, the buyer taking free of it; the manager who said 'we'll take you back' and has given notice; the side letter with the fund's partner that the successor manager has never seen; the supplier's verbal priority that leaves with the account executive. Threshold: the transfer of title or role, which you do not control and often do not see coming. Tell: the for-sale sign on the lawn; earlier, the awkwardness of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement, which is the sign the promise lives in a person. Changed move: recording, a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put on the paper that binds successors, at the cost of that awkwardness. Neighbours: term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair is the mirror, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have; here the replacement declines to honour a term the friend gave. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.

Chair grown over. The option to return rests on a vacancy the counterparty has not yet re-planned, and it expires at the next planning cycle without anyone deciding against you; the absence is simply absorbed. Lost: a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could receive you. What expires is the return to the seat; employment there afterwards is a new negotiation, from outside. Carrier: the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, which sets the date without reference to you. Cases: the leave taken with no return date, the post split among three at the reorganization; the budget line reallocated at year end; the supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed; the co-founder's seat that stops being left empty at the next hire. Threshold: the cycle turns. Tell: nobody has asked when you are coming back; the quarter is closing and no one has mentioned your chair, and that silence is the whole of the warning. Changed move: a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle must respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns. Neighbours: traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant is the case where preparing for a future breeds its opponents; here nobody opposes the return. Not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way; this road has closed.

Sixty-day signatures. An option that needs many simultaneous yeses is not lost all at once; it goes one yes at a time, from the back, and the gathering has to outrun the decay or the whole thing sours. Lost: a coordination. Carrier: the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention. Cases: Michigan invalidates recall signatures older than sixty days; California requires all of them to fall within a hundred and sixty; the tender offer's minimum condition must be met by the offer's expiry; the crowd in the square goes home; the reunion becomes impossible one death at a time. The recall and tender cases are observed; the crowd is an analogy. Threshold: the oldest assent falls out of the window before the last one arrives. Tell: the dates on the earliest sheets, read against the pace of the newest. Changed move: a gathering rate, paid circulators, a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last one arrives. Neighbours: who-can-be-bound's Place in line is an ordering lost by your leaving; this is the coordination lost by others' leaving. Not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter; here many small calendars do.

Approval ceiling. The holder's own growth carries the natural acquirer out of reach: the option to sell expires at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all, with nobody at either table declining. Lost: a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option. Carrier: the acquirer's capacity, legible in its market value and deal history, a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling, set against your own price, which each round raises. Cases: a preference stack already past the largest deal any of your three strategic buyers has ever done; the player's wage that outgrows every club in the league but two; the practice too large for any partner to buy in and too small to list. This is analytical, since every observed case can be read as a buyer who would have paid more; it stands as a mechanism and not as a count. Threshold: the round that prices you past the ceiling. Tell: a number in the acquirer's filings that nobody in the room has checked, read against your own term sheet before you sign; each round is a celebration. Changed move: the sale at the last price under the ceiling, which was never seen as the last, or a round sized to stay under it, the one choice a founder is never advised to make. Neighbours: market-deaths' Slowed past the rot is a market that thins from the outside; this is the market for you that you thin by growing. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans; here the counterparty is unchanged and you have left its range.

Pour the foundation. A rule change takes the permission unless the holder has substantially begun exercising it before the effective date, and nothing on paper substitutes: not the permit, not the plans, not the letter. Lost: a permission. Carrier: the code and the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, Washington among them, on a complete application, so the last act differs by jurisdiction and the holder who knows which applies has a different week than the holder who does not. Cases: the footings poured the week of the zoning vote; the nonconforming use that survives the new code only if in use on the effective date; the grandfathered rate kept only by the account that was open. Threshold: the ordinance passes. Tell: not on the agenda but in the ground; when the rule begins to move, read your own site for what has actually started. Changed move: the hole in the ground before the vote, an exercise begun rather than a filing made; the option is preserved only by starting to use it. Neighbours: first-mover-forecloses holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose; this is the rule that changes for reasons of its own. Not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated to keep the right; here one beginning vests it for good.

Slot flown empty. A permission expires by disuse and is kept only by exercise: the clock runs while you do nothing, stops only when you act, and the act that keeps it is the exercise emptied of its purpose. Lost: a permission. Carrier: the regulator's usage ledger. Cases: the airport slot must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, and in early 2020 airlines flew empty planes until the rule was waived; the water right under prior appropriation is forfeited after five years without beneficial use, so fields are irrigated in a drought to keep it; the trade mark abandoned after three years' non-use; the mining claim kept by annual labour; the department budget spent in the last quarter so it is not cut. Threshold: the ledger's usage floor. Tell: the aircraft taking off with nobody aboard is not waste, it is the tell; watch the ledger, not the situation, since the ledger is where the quiet accumulates. Changed move: the empty flight, which costs the whole price of using the option and returns nothing but the option, so that keeping and using become one act and the upkeep is the exercise price. Neighbours: runway-illusions' Stamp's clock is the licence that lapses without hours logged and that no cash extends; this is the price at which it can be extended after all, the hours flown for nobody. Tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry has the gate spending its stamp; here the permission-holder must burn the permission to keep it. Power-trades' Leased strike has disuse making a power unbelieved; here disuse forfeits it by rule. Not Pour the foundation, one act that vests; here no act ever finishes the keeping.

Thawed to be ready. Preparing to exercise the option starts a decay the unprepared state did not have, so the option to wait expires because the option to act was made ready. Lost: a capability, the good itself spoiling in its ready state. Carrier: a chemistry, or a season, that begins at preparation. Cases: the vaccine vial keeps for months frozen, weeks once thawed, hours once punctured; the epoxy's pot life begins at mixing; the drawn dose, the armed fuze, the reagent brought to room temperature, the opened surgical field; the reserve army that cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from. Threshold: closing time, pot life, the harvest. Tell: count the tray against the bookings; whatever is not used by closing is gone, and it was not gone yesterday. Changed move: not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit, the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings. The clinic that thaws a whole tray to be sure of serving whoever comes has bought its readiness with the doses it will discard at closing. Neighbours: the mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched; here it dies of being touched, and a holder who holds both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other. Not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting, which does not spoil for having been rehearsed. Not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day; here it falls on the good.

First responsive pleading. The option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is your own next act rather than a date: do nothing and you keep it; do anything adjacent and it is gone. Lost: a permission.
