Cases: the objection to the court's jurisdiction over you, waived if not in the first response; the patent dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and in the United States a year after; the appeal waived by accepting the settlement; the election of remedies; the defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used; speak now at the wedding or hold your peace. Threshold: your first adjacent act. Tell: that you have not looked for the rule that says what has to come first. Changed move: the ordering itself, the provisional filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the goods are unpacked, each costing nothing but the knowledge that an order exists. Neighbours: not Slot flown empty, where inaction runs the clock; here inaction is the only thing that keeps it. Not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date and you are the only one who can strike.

First write. The option to reverse a move expires at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read; the window is the pause between the change and its first consequence, and it closes without anyone closing it. Lost: a capability, the old state's ability to take over from here. Carrier: the first write, performed by the new state as routine and not as any decision about reversal. Cases: the new service's first record, in a shape the old schema cannot read; the merger reversible until the first combined payroll; the new address until the first piece of mail arrives there; the reorganization until the first hire into the new chart; the currency changeover until the first contract written in the new unit. Threshold: the first write. Tell: not an alarm but the first ordinary transaction; you have to be watching for the ordinary. Changed move: the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth. Neighbours: pivot-invariants names the retained assets that make leaving cheap; this is the moment one of them is lost. Undo-costs bills a reversal that remains possible; this is the reversal that stops being possible. Not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good; here the new state's use closes the way back to the old.

Kept on the machine. The option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm or whose lapse is one-way, so the deadline is the machine's and not the situation's. Lost: a capability, the eligibility or the workings. Carrier: the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill. Cases: the patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant, week three on the circuit, bleeding, infection and clotting each a little higher than last week against the centre's own written limit beyond which candidacy is reviewed (centre practice, simplified); the mothballed mine kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening; the reserve-fleet ship whose hull is kept by cathodic protection a budget line can end; the interim chief who has run the company past the point where the search can bring in an outsider. Threshold: the centre's limit, the budget line, the point past which no outsider can come. Tell: the day the bridge begins, since on that day the machine's clock is already running against the thing it holds open; the numbers that matter are not the ones on the monitor. Changed move: the listing at the moment of cannulation, the search begun the day the interim was named, the decision to stop pumping taken while a sale was still possible, each treating the bridge's start as the option's deadline. Neighbours: lead-time-floors' Bridge is a degraded replacement priced by the hour; this is the bridge that ends the option it holds open. Not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs; here the clock is a harm nobody signs.

Standstill with a term. The holder writes a deadline into a situation that had none, to keep an option open, and the renewal of the paper belongs to the adversary, who now knows exactly what the pause is worth. Lost: a permission, the leave to remain in the paused state. Carrier: the pause's own instrument, the one clock in the situation you wrote yourself. Cases: the tolling agreement, twelve months, stopping a limitations clock you could have stopped alone by filing, expiring unless the adversary signs again; the negotiated leave that dates a job which had no date and is extended only if the employer signs; the forbearance holding the lender's foreclosure for ninety days; the furlough's recall rights running six months; the takeover standstill that keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says. Threshold: the term's end without the counter-signature; month ten of twelve. Tell: a signature you need that is not yours. Changed move: the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, which is rarely granted; the Korean armistice is the exception, with no renewal date and still called temporary. Boundary: the statutory pauses, the family-leave statute's twelve weeks and the restraining order's fourteen days, are the same date without the mechanism, since the term is a rule's and renewal belongs to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it; those are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock. Neighbours: impasse-inventions' cooling-off right offers reversibility as a chip; this is the bill the chip carries. Not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search; here the search is stopped, and the stopping is what expires.
F: Sunday decree. Mechanism: an authority closes the exit by rule on a whole class, and the one condition of doing it is that nobody is told, since the telling would be the cue to leave; so it lands in the hours the holder is locked out anyway. Greek banks did not open on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday speech. Cyprus declared a bank holiday in March 2013 and extended it when parliament voted down the first levy, until the bail-in was law. Argentina announced the corralito on a Saturday in December 2001. Export licences are suspended and listings removed, the notice published afterwards. What is lost is a permission: leave to move what is yours. Carrier: the authority's calendar, arranged to coincide with Friday night and the bank holiday. Threshold: the decree itself; it must strike before it can be known, so no date exists to wait for and the mechanism issues no notice. Tell: a weekend, a holiday, a Sunday speech, deposits leaving on rumour at the discount the rumour market charges. Changed next move: the transfer made on the rumour, paying that discount and the cost of being wrong; the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing firmer. Fence: not a lapse the holder can test by letting it pass, and not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure decided at the holder's own table; a decree rules on a class and consults no one. The decree names the exit; it is not a side effect. Supplies runway-illusions' Cash behind glass the reason it was a Friday.

Bar date in the newspaper. Mechanism: the claim expires on a date fixed in a proceeding the holder does not attend, on the legal theory that the holder read about it. The bankruptcy court sets a bar date for proofs of claim and notifies the creditors it cannot name by a newspaper notice. The class settlement's opt-out date arrives on a postcard that looks like advertising. The probate creditor's window opens when the notice runs in the county paper and closes some weeks later. What is lost is a permission: standing to be paid, or to sue on one's own. Carrier: the bar-date order plus constructive notice, under which publication counts as knowledge for anyone the debtor could not name. Threshold: the date on the docket, credited to the holder whether or not the holder ever saw it. Tell: a legal notice in small print, a postcard from a settlement administrator, a county-paper run; the holder is missing from the room while the record stays complete. Changed next move: the one-page proof of claim or the signed opt-out, the cheapest filing in the law and the one least often made, because the person who would make it is by construction the person who was not told. Supplies runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, where the date is printed on the stamp, the date written on someone else's docket. Not deal-deaths' Missing witness: nothing is missing from the record.

Parent paper. Mechanism: the option was issued under a parent instrument with a term of its own, so it ends when the parent ends, on its merits or not, and the option carries no date; the date sits on a different piece of paper. The emergency-use authorization ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency, which ended in May 2023 while the authorizations stayed up, surprising people who assumed one paper. Cross-state telehealth licences lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022, state by state. The wartime power, the pilot under a waiver, the sub-lease ending with the head lease: the same. What is lost is a permission. Carrier: the parent's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read. Threshold: the parent's termination, whichever paper carries it; step one is finding out which. Tell: a grant with no date on its face, an emergency that looks permanent, a waiver nobody has re-read. Changed next move: conversion, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in the holder's own name, filed while the parent still stands; conversion is slow enough that it must begin while the emergency looks endless, which is exactly when nobody begins it. Not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date is imputed; here the date is honest, just on another paper. Not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes; this rule imposes no wait. It ends.

Patch before seven. Mechanism: the option expires on the holder's own developmental schedule, which the holder cannot read, so the last intervention sits by arrangement in somebody else's hand. Amblyopia is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years; after about seven the response drops, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens, so seven is approximate and the eye has not read the trials. The clubfoot is cast in infancy. The second language is accentless if learned early, a disputed window. The duckling imprints on its first day on whatever is there. What is lost is a capability: the cortex's willingness to rewire. Carrier: the developmental timetable, running in a child who has not been told there is an eye to save. Threshold: roughly age seven for the eye, with a long soft tail; earlier for the foot. Tell: a squint, a preschool vision check failed or never given; where there is no screening programme, the option expires unseen at a rate that belongs to the programme, not the child, and the programme is not audited for it. Changed next move: the screening, the preschool check, the parent who notices; the option belongs to one person and its preservation to another, and that is the arrangement. Supplies Last known well the case where the holder cannot be its own witness at all. Not a use-it-or-lose-it: nothing the child does runs the clock. The child is not involved.

Last known well. Mechanism: the option is dated by the last person who saw the fact, not by the fact, so it expires when the proof runs out; the body is available for comment and not consulted. The stroke patient wakes with the deficit and is ineligible for thrombolysis, because the four-and-a-half-hour window counts from last seen well, which was bedtime; the artery may have closed at six, but nobody was there at six, so it closed at bedtime. The same rule dates the opened vial with no time on the label and the sample with a gap in its chain of custody: expired at the earliest moment they could have, since nobody can say they did not. What is lost is a capability: a treatment the protocol now declines to give. Carrier: the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and does not ask the tissue. Threshold: the window counted from the last witnessed moment, not the true onset. Tell: a wake-up deficit, an unlabelled vial, a custody gap; the record's clock has run even where the body's may not have. Changed next move: a witness, someone awake, a time written on the vial; or a witness of another kind, imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 gave the drug back to patients nobody had watched. Supplies witness-architectures the option that dies for lack of a trace while the fact would still permit it. Not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run.

Moot before the forum sits. Mechanism: the option to a decision expires because the situation finishes before the forum reaches it, so nobody declines, nobody rules, and the file closes as complete. The pregnancy ends before the appeal. The election is held before the ballot-access case. The tenant is evicted before housing court sits. Tell: a hearing date that lands after the harm's own calendar, a plaintiff whose status will change before judgment. Not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile: nothing is eaten, the harm is simply over. Not Bar date in the newspaper.

Supplies deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote. Not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer; here by the calendar.

Pour the foundation. Mechanism: a permission is about to be withdrawn by a third party's rule change and can be kept only by an act in the world, no paper accepted in lieu. The building may proceed under the old zoning only if the developer substantially began, in reliance on a valid permit, before the ordinance passed; so the footings are poured the week of the council vote, and the concrete truck is, strictly, the filing. The nonconforming use survives the new code only if in use on the effective date. The grandfathered rate is kept only by the account that was open. What is lost is a permission. Carrier: the code and the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application, so the last act differs by jurisdiction and the holder who knows which has a different week from the one who does not. Threshold: the ordinance's effective date, or the council vote. Tell: a rezoning on the agenda, a code revision in comment period, a permit in hand and no hole in the ground. Changed next move: the hole before the vote, an exercise begun rather than a filing made; the option is preserved only by starting to use it, and the hole is inspected. Supplies first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose, the rule that changes for its own reasons with no rival attached. Not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must repeat; here one beginning vests for good, and the hole can stay a hole.

Slot flown empty. Mechanism: the permission expires by disuse and is kept only by exercise, so the clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the act that keeps it is the exercise with its purpose removed. The airport slot must be flown eighty percent of the season or returned, so in early 2020 airlines flew empty aircraft between cities until the rule was waived, the aircraft arriving on time. The water right under prior appropriation is forfeited after five years without beneficial use, so fields are irrigated in a drought to keep the right. The trade mark is abandoned after three years' non-use. The mining claim is kept by annual labour. The department budget is spent in the last quarter so it is not cut. What is lost is a permission. Carrier: the regulator's usage ledger. Threshold: the eighty percent, the five years, the three years, the year's labour; the season starts at zero each time. Tell: a usage ratio drifting under the line, a right on the books with no hours against it. Changed next move: the empty flight, which costs the full price of using the option and returns nothing but the option, so that keeping and using are the same act and the upkeep is the exercise price, paid in fuel. Supplies runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapses without hours logged, the price at which it can be extended after all: hours flown for nobody. Supplies tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry the holder who must burn the permission to keep it, and power-trades' Leased strike the disuse that forfeits by rule. Not Pour the foundation, one act that vests; here no act ever finishes the keeping.

Thawed to be ready. Mechanism: preparing to exercise the option starts a decay the unprepared state did not have, so the option to wait expires because the option to act was made ready, which was the point. The vaccine vial keeps months frozen, weeks thawed, hours once punctured, each step toward the patient costing an order of magnitude of shelf. The epoxy's pot life begins at mixing. The drawn dose, the armed fuze, the reagent at room temperature, the opened surgical field, all counting. The reserve army cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from. What is lost is a capability: the good itself, spoiling in its ready state. Carrier: a chemistry or a season that begins at preparation and not before. Threshold: the shelf life of the ready state, hours to weeks. Tell: a tray thawed for whoever might come, a batch mixed for the whole day, doses discarded at closing. Changed next move: not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit, the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings; the clinic that thaws a tray to be sure of serving everyone has bought its readiness with the doses it discards at closing. Mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched; here it dies of being touched, and a holder of both must burn one and refrain from readying the other, and keep them straight. Not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy that does not spoil for having rehearsed. Not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day; here it falls on the good, which is discarded.

First responsive pleading. Mechanism: the option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is the holder's own next act rather than a date; the holder who does nothing keeps it and the holder who does anything nearby loses it, the rule satisfied either way. The objection to personal jurisdiction is waived if left out of the first response, which has been filed. The patent is dead in Europe the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States, the talk having gone well. The appeal is waived by accepting the settlement. The election of remedies is made by electing one. The defect in the goods must be objected to before use, and the goods have been used. 'Speak now' is followed by the rest of the wedding. What is lost is a permission. Carrier: a rule that ties the option to a position in a sequence, the sequence written somewhere other than the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code, so the holder learns the order from the loss. Threshold: the holder's own first act on the linked matter. Tell: a first filing being drafted, a talk scheduled, goods unpacked, a settlement about to be signed. Changed next move: the ordering itself, the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the crates are opened, each costing nothing except knowing that an order exists, which is the expensive part. Not Slot flown empty, where inaction runs the clock; here inaction is the only thing that keeps it. Not Bar date in the newspaper; there is no date, and the holder alone strikes, and does.

First write. Mechanism: the option to reverse a move expires at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read, so the window is the pause between the change and its first consequence, and it closes with nobody deciding to close it; the new state has simply gone to work. The migration can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects, which it does on the first request. The merger is reversible until the first combined payroll, on the usual day. The new address, until the first piece of mail. The reorganization, until the first hire into the new chart. The currency changeover, until the first contract in the new unit, which was the purpose of the changeover. What is lost is a capability: the old state's ability to take over from here. Carrier: the first write, performed in the ordinary course of business and not a decision about reversal at all. Threshold: the first record the old schema cannot read, the first payroll, the first letter. Tell: a cutover with no dual-write period, a rollback plan whose deadline is the first customer request. Changed next move: the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth, which is tolerated. Supplies pivot-invariants the moment a retained asset is lost, and undo-costs the reversal that stops being possible and is therefore not billed. Not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good; here the good is fine and the new state's use closes the way back.

Kept on the machine. Mechanism: the option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm, or whose lapse is one-way, so the deadline is the machine's and not the situation's. The patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant becomes ineligible for the transplant the circuit was keeping her alive for, since bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit and centres set a duration past which candidacy is reviewed. The mothballed mine is kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening, so the pumps run in a mine producing nothing, on a budget line. The reserve-fleet ship keeps her hull by cathodic protection a budget line can end. The interim chief has run the company past the point at which the search can bring in an outsider, the search having gone well. What is lost is a capability: the eligibility or the workings. Carrier: the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill. Threshold: the centre's duration limit, the budget line's end, the interim's tenure crossing the point of no outsider; the ECMO limits are centre practice and simplified. Tell: weeks on circuit counted against a review, a pump line up for cuts, an interim whose search has quietly stopped. Changed next move: the listing at cannulation, the search begun the day the interim was named, the decision to stop pumping while a sale was still possible, each treating the bridge's start as the option's deadline, which it was. Supplies lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour, the bridge that ends the option it holds open, on schedule. Not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs; here it is a harm nobody signs, keeping time anyway.

Standstill with a term. Mechanism: a pause taken to keep an option open is written on a paper with a date, so a situation that had no deadline now has one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who has been told by the paper what the pause is worth to the holder. The tolling agreement stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing, and expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again. The negotiated leave dates a job that had no date and extends only if the employer signs. The forbearance holds the lender's foreclosure ninety days, the lender counting. The furlough's recall rights run six months. The takeover standstill keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says. What is lost is a permission: leave to remain in the paused state. Carrier: the pause's own instrument, the only clock in the situation the holder wrote, and wrote voluntarily. Threshold: the paper's date, twelve months, ninety days, six months. Tell: a renewal that must be asked for, from the party across the table, who now knows what to charge. Changed next move: the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, rarely granted; the Korean armistice has no renewal date and is still called temporary. The statutory pauses, the family-leave statute's twelve weeks and the restraining order's fourteen days, are the same date without the mechanism, the renewal belonging to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty; those are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock. Supplies impasse-inventions' cooling-off right the bill the chip carries. Not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search; here the search is stopped, and the stopping is what expires.
G: Weekend closure. A previously available exit is shut by an authority's rule on a class, timed to the hours when no one can act on it, because any notice of the closure would itself start the run it is meant to prevent. The Greek banks that did not open on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday address; the Cypriot bank holiday of March 2013, extended after parliament rejected the first levy until the bail-in was law; the Argentine corralito announced on a Saturday in December 2001; the export licence suspended, the delisting published after the fact. Condition lost: a permission, the leave to move what is yours. Carrier: the authority's calendar, aligned to the hours the holder is locked out (Friday night, bank holiday, Sunday decree). Last intervention: a transfer made on rumour, carrying the full cost of being wrong and the discount the rumour market charges; the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing better. Tell: this is the one expiry on the map whose notice cannot precede it; a holder waiting for a date is waiting for something the mechanism forbids to exist. Changed next move: act on the rumour or not at all; no date will come. Adds to runway-illusions' Cash behind glass, which counts the deposit taken into receivership on a Friday as owned and unreachable: this is the mechanism that chose the Friday. Not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse the founder can probe by letting it pass, since a closure that can be probed need not be a surprise; not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, which someone at the holder's own table decides, since the decree is an authority's rule on a class and no one at the table decided about the holder. The item rests on that boundary and not on any claim that the exit dies as a side effect: the decree forbids the exit by name.

Bar date in the newspaper. The standing to be paid or to sue on one's own is cut off on a date fixed in a proceeding the holder was not party to, and the holder is deemed to have read it. The bankruptcy court's bar date for proofs of claim, noticed to creditors the debtor could not name by publication in a newspaper; the class settlement whose opt-out date arrives on a postcard that looks like advertising; the probate creditor's window that opens and closes after the notice runs in the county paper. Condition lost: a permission, the standing to be paid or to sue individually. Carrier: the bar-date order together with the rule of constructive notice, under which publication counts as the holder's knowledge precisely because no one could name them. Last intervention: a one-page proof of claim or a signed opt-out, the cheapest filing in the law and the least often made, because the person who would make it is by construction the one who was not told. Tell: the date exists and is readable, but on someone else's docket; not having been told is no defence. Changed next move: read the legal notices in any forum where one might be an unnamed creditor or class member, and file the one page. Adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a permission with a date readable on the stamp: here the date is written on another party's docket and imputed to the holder. Not deal-deaths' Missing witness, since nothing is missing from the record, only the holder from the room.

Emergency over. A permission carved out of a parent instrument ends when the parent's term ends, whatever the grant's own merits, and the grant itself carries no date. The emergency-use authorization that ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing; the cross-state telehealth licence that lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022; the wartime power; the pilot programme run under a waiver; the sub-lease that dies with the head lease. Condition lost: a permission. Carrier: the parent instrument's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read, since the grant the holder did read carried no date; the first task is to find which parent paper carries the date. Last intervention: conversion (a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in the holder's own name) filed while the parent still stands; conversion is slow enough that it must begin while the emergency looks endless, which is exactly when no one wants to begin it. Tell: a grant with no expiry printed on it that was issued 'under' something else. Changed next move: identify the parent instrument and its term, then start conversion while the temporary grant is still in force. Not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date is on a docket and imputed, since here the date is on a different paper than the option and is honest; not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes, since here the rule does not wait but ends.

Patch before seven. A capability closes on a developmental timetable the holder cannot read, so the last intervention is necessarily in another party's hand. Amblyopia is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years and responds less, and less completely, after about seven, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens; the clubfoot cast in infancy; the second language spoken without an accent, contested as a hard window; the duckling that imprints in its first day. Condition lost: a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire. Carrier: the developmental timetable; the holder is a child who does not know there is an eye to save. Last intervention: screening (the preschool vision check, the parent who notices a squint), so the option belongs to one person and its keeping to another; where no screening programme exists the option expires unseen at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of the child. Tell: the holder cannot be its own witness; the keeping is done on the holder's behalf or not at all. Changed next move: build or use the screening programme; the child will never raise it. Adds to Last known well, where a witness dates the option: this is the case in which the holder cannot witness at all. Not a use-it-or-lose-it, since nothing the child does or leaves undone runs the clock.

Last known well. A treatment the body might still permit is refused because the protocol dates the option by the last witness to onset rather than by the tissue, so it expires when the proof runs out while the body might still allow it. The stroke patient who wakes with the deficit is ineligible for thrombolysis because the four-and-a-half-hour window is counted from when she was last seen well, which was bedtime, so the wake-up stroke loses the drug regardless of when the artery closed; the same rule dates the opened vial with no time written on the label and the sample whose chain of custody has a gap, each treated as expired at the earliest time it could have been. Condition lost: a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids. Carrier: the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue. Last intervention: a witness (someone awake, a time written on the vial) or a witness of a different kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 returned the drug to patients with no witnessed onset. Tell: the thing is physically still on the table and is denied on a proof. Changed next move: attack the proof, not the physiology: write the time on the vial, get the imaging. Adds to witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form: the option that dies for want of a trace while the fact would still allow it. Not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run, since here the body's clock may not have run and the record's has.

Mooted. A ruling is never given because the harm ended before the forum reached it; no one had to refuse and no one ruled. The student whose challenge to a law school's admissions was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974); the pregnancy over before the appeal; the election held before the ballot-access case; the tenant evicted before the housing court sits; the employee whose grievance is mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post. Condition lost: a permission, the justiciability of the claim. Carrier: the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number set by no one at the holder's table. Last intervention: a structure that outlives the individual harm: the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, on which Roe rested. Tell: there is no date anywhere; the harm simply ends first. Changed next move: the option is kept by a coordination or by a rule and never by hurrying; build the claim larger than one plaintiff before that plaintiff's harm ends. Not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where the surplus is eaten on a curve, since here nothing is eaten and the harm is simply over; not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date.

Session ends. The body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter still pending, and its successor starts the matter at zero without ever saying no. The bills that die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from the beginning; the treaty signed and waiting on a parliament that is dissolved; the permit application before a council that is re-elected; the approval the old board agreed in the hallway and had not yet minuted when the board was reconstituted at the meeting; the offer approved by a committee that the reorganization disbanded. What expires is the matter's place in the process. Condition lost: a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was available. Carrier: the ratifier's own calendar: election, session, or term. Last intervention: the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway. The treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone; the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no. Tell: an informal yes from a body that has a term. Changed next move: get the minute, not the nod; the nod dies with the body that gave it. Adds to deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain: here the ratifier wanted this one and was gone before the vote. Not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer, since here it is replaced by the calendar.

Landlord changes. A promise made by a person rather than written on the paper that transfers dies at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder does not control and often does not see. The renewal promised by the landlord who sells the building to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises; the 'we'll take you back' from a manager who leaves; the side letter with a fund's partner that the fund's successor manager has never seen; the supplier's verbal priority that vanishes with the account executive. Condition lost: a counterparty, the one whose word held the option. Carrier: the register (the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead) on which the option was never written, so the successor takes free of it. Last intervention: recording: a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put on the paper that binds successors, at the cost of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement. Tell: the promise lives in a person, not on the instrument that transfers. Changed next move: accept the awkwardness and record it. Adds to term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have: the mirror case, where the replacement declines to honour a term the friend gave. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.

Chair grown over. A return to a seat is lost when the vacancy is absorbed at the counterparty's next planning cycle, with no one declining the return. The leave taken with no return date whose post is redistributed among three people at the next reorganization; the budget line reallocated at year end; the supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed; the co-founder's seat that the remaining founders stop leaving empty at the next hire. What expires is the return to the seat; employment there afterwards is a new negotiation from the outside. Condition lost: a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could receive the holder. Carrier: the counterparty's planning cadence (quarterly, annual, the next reorganization), which sets the expiry without reference to the holder at all. Last intervention: a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle must respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns. Tell: an open-ended absence against a counterparty that has a planning cycle. Changed next move: put a date on the return; an intention to return is not a reservation, only a date is. Adds to traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant, where preparation for a future breeds its opponents: here no one opposes the return and the absence is simply absorbed. Not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way, since this road has closed.

Petition that goes stale. An option that requires simultaneous assent expires unless the gathering outruns the decay of every assent; a coordination has a half-life. The recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days; the tender offer's minimum condition that must be met by the offer's expiry; the crowd in the square that goes home; the reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time. Condition lost: a coordination. Carrier: the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention. Last intervention: a gathering rate (paid circulators), a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives. The recall and tender cases are observed; the crowd is analogy. Tell: many small clocks, each started by an assent, none of them the holder's. Changed next move: collect at a rate that beats the decay, or bind the early assents; collecting one at a time is how the first ones spoil. Adds to who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving: here the coordination is lost by others' leaving. Not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter, since here many small calendars do.

Outgrown the buyer. The company whose preference stack now exceeds the largest deal its three strategic buyers have ever done; the player whose wage outgrows every club in the league but two; the practice too large for any partner to buy in and too small to be listed. Condition lost: a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option. Carrier: the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and its deal history, set against the holder's own price, which each round raises. Last intervention: the sale at the last price under the ceiling, never recognized as the last, or a round sized to stay under it, the one choice a founder is never advised to make. Changed next move: read the buyers' capacity before pricing the round, and treat the ceiling as a deadline. Adds to market-deaths' Slowed past the rot, where a market thins from the outside: here the holder thins its own market by growing. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans, since here the counterparty is unchanged and the holder has left its range.

Last intervention: the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so that the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth. Tell: the new state's first ordinary output is the deadline, and no one will announce it. Changed next move: dual-write for a season, or accept that the first write ends the rollback. Adds to pivot-invariants, which name the retained assets that make leaving cheap: the moment at which one of them is lost. Adds to undo-costs, which bills a reversal that remains possible: the reversal that stops being possible. Not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good, since here the new state's use closes the way back to the old.

Kept on the machine. An option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm or whose lapse is one-way, so the deadline is the machine's and not the situation's. The patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant who becomes ineligible for the transplant the machine was keeping her alive for, since bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit and centres set a duration beyond which candidacy is reviewed; the mothballed mine kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening; the ship in the reserve fleet whose hull is kept by cathodic protection that a budget line can end; the interim chief who has run the company past the point where the search can bring in an outsider. Condition lost: a capability, the eligibility or the workings. Carrier: the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill. Last intervention: a listing at the moment of cannulation, a search begun the day the interim was named, a decision to stop pumping taken while a sale was still possible, each treating the bridge's start as the option's deadline. The ECMO limits are centre practice and are simplified. Tell: the bridge's own start is the deadline; the situation has none of its own. Changed next move: on the day the bridge starts, start the far-shore process; a bridge started without it holds open nothing. Adds to lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour: the bridge that ends the option it holds open. Not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs, since here the clock is a harm no one signs.

Standstill with a term. A negotiated pause puts a date on a situation that had none, and the renewal belongs to the other side, who now knows exactly what the pause is worth to the holder. The tolling agreement that stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing and that expires in twelve months unless the adversary signs again; the negotiated leave of absence that dates a job which had no date and is extended only if the employer signs; the forbearance agreement that holds the lender's foreclosure for ninety days; the furlough whose recall rights run six months; the standstill in a takeover that keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says. Condition lost: a permission, the leave to remain in the paused state. Carrier: the pause's own instrument, the only clock in the situation that the holder wrote. Last intervention: the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, which is rarely granted; the Korean armistice is the exception that has no renewal date and is still called temporary. The statutory pauses (the twelve weeks of the family-leave statute, the restraining order's fourteen days) are the same date without the mechanism, since the term is a rule's and the renewal belongs to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it; those are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock. Tell: the holder signed the only dated paper in the matter, and the adversary read the price off the signature. Changed next move: ask for the renewal early, or file instead of tolling where filing alone would stop the clock. Adds to impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip: the bill the chip carries. Not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search, since here the search is stopped and the stopping is what expires.
H: A closure by decree that must strike before it can be known, since the warning would itself start the run it exists to stop, so it lands unsaid in the hours the holder cannot act: the Friday night, the bank holiday, the Sunday address. Greek banks did not open on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday address; the Cypriot bank holiday of March 2013 was stretched, after parliament refused the first levy, until the bail-in was law; the Argentine corralito was told to people on a Saturday in December 2001; the export licence suspended and the delisting published after it had already happened. Lost: a permission, the leave to carry what is yours out of the building. Carrier: the authority's calendar, laid over the hours in which the holder cannot act. Threshold: the decree itself; by construction no notice precedes it, and waiting for a date is waiting for the one thing the mechanism forbids itself from giving. Tell: none by design. Changed next move: move on a rumour and pay twice, in the chance of being wrong and in the discount the rumour market charges; the deposits that left Greece that spring left on whispers. Beside runway-illusions' Cash behind glass, which counts the deposit taken into receivership on a Friday as yours and unreachable; this item chose the Friday. Not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse a founder can test by letting it burn: a closure that can be probed is not one that must surprise. Not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, which someone at the holder's own table decides; here a rule fell on a whole class and nobody decided about the holder. The decree forbade the exit by name; the exit did not die as a side effect.

Bar date in the newspaper. A last day fixed on someone else's docket and served by publication, so the law imputes knowledge to the very people it could not reach. The bankruptcy court sets a bar date for proofs of claim and tells the creditors it cannot name by printing it in a newspaper; the class settlement's opt-out date arrives on a postcard that looks like an advertisement and goes in the bin; the probate creditor's window opens and shuts after the notice runs in the county paper. Lost: a permission, the standing to be paid or to sue on one's own behalf. Carrier: the bar-date order, with the rule of constructive notice beside it, under which publication counts as knowledge for anyone the debtor could not name. Threshold: the printed date. Tell: none reaches the holder; the person who would have filed is, by construction, the person who was not told, so the filing is the cheapest in all of law and the one least often made. Changed next move: a single page, a proof of claim or a signed opt-out. Beside runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, where the permission carries a date readable on the stamp; this is the date written somewhere the holder was not. Not deal-deaths' Missing witness: nothing is missing from the record, only the holder from the room.

A permission granted under a parent instrument carries no date of its own and ends on the parent's date, whatever the grant's merits. The emergency-use authorization ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a different paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing; the cross-state telehealth licence lapsed with each state's emergency in 2021 and 2022; the wartime power; the pilot programme run under a waiver; the sub-lease that dies with the head lease. Lost: a permission. Carrier: the parent instrument's date. Threshold: the parent's termination. Tell: the grant the holder read carries no date, so before the clock can be watched the holder must find which parent paper it is written on. Changed next move: conversion, a full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in the holder's own name, filed while the parent still stands; conversion is slow enough that it must begin while the emergency looks as if it will never end, the season in which nobody begins it. Not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date is on a docket and imputed; here the date is honest and simply on a different paper. Not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait a rule imposes; here the rule does not make the holder wait, it ends.

Patch before seven. The option ends by the holder's own development, on a timetable the holder cannot read, so its keeping belongs to another pair of hands. Amblyopia is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years and answers less, and less completely, after about seven, though the trials of the 2000s found some response into the early teens; the clubfoot cast in infancy; the second language spoken without an accent, argued over as a hard window; the duckling that imprints in its first day. Lost: a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire. Carrier: the developmental timetable. Threshold: about seven for the eye, soft at the edges. Tell: the holder gives none; a parent notices a squint, or a preschool vision check does. Changed next move: screening; where there is no programme the option goes out unseen at a rate that is a property of the programme and not of the child. Beside Last known well, where a witness dates the option; here the holder cannot be its own witness at all. Not a use-it-or-lose-it: nothing the child does or leaves undone runs this clock faster or slower.

Last known well. The option is dated by the last witness to the fact rather than by the fact, so it runs out when the proof runs out while the tissue might still allow it. The woman who wakes with the deficit is ineligible for thrombolysis because the four-and-a-half-hour window is counted from when she was last seen well, which was bedtime, so the wake-up stroke loses the drug whenever the artery actually closed; the opened vial with no time on its label and the sample with a gap in its chain of custody are both treated as expired at the earliest moment they could have been. Lost: a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids. Carrier: the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue. Threshold: the window measured from the last witness. Tell: the paper says no while the body has not been asked. Changed next move: a witness; someone awake, a time written on the vial, or the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 gave the drug back to patients with no witnessed onset. Beside witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form; this is the option that dies for want of a trace while the fact would still have allowed it. Not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run; here the body's clock may not have run at all, and the record's has.

The situation resolves faster than the forum that would decide it can move, so nobody declines and nobody rules. The student whose challenge to a law school's admissions was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974); the pregnancy over before the appeal; the election held before the ballot-access case; the tenant evicted before the housing court sits; the employee whose grievance is mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post. Lost: a permission, the justiciability of the claim. Carrier: the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number nobody at the table sets. Threshold: the harm ends before the ruling. Tell: there is no date anywhere in it. Changed next move: not speed, since hurrying does not save this one, but a structure that outlives the individual harm: the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review may be decided anyway, on which Roe rested; kept by a coordination or a rule, never by hurrying. Not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where surplus is eaten along a curve; here nothing is eaten, the harm is simply over. Not Bar date in the newspaper.

Session ends. The body that could have approved reaches the end of its own term with the matter still pending, and its successor starts it at zero. Bills die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from the first line; the treaty signed and waiting on a parliament that is dissolved; the permit application before a council that is re-elected; the approval the old board agreed in the hallway and had not minuted when the board was reconstituted at the meeting; the offer approved by a committee the reorganization disbands. Expires: the matter's place in the process. Lost: a counterparty, the particular body whose yes was there for the taking. Carrier: the ratifier's own calendar, its election, its session, its term. Threshold: adjournment or reconstitution with the matter pending. Tell: no recorded no anywhere. Changed next move: the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway; the small clerical acts that let a warm yes survive the people who gave it. The treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone; the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand each session with no recorded no. Beside deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain; this is the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote. Not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by a transfer; here it is replaced by the calendar.

Landlord changes. An option held in a person rather than on the paper that transfers ends at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder does not control and often does not see. The renewal promised by the landlord who sells the building to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises; the 'we'll take you back' from a manager who moves on; the side letter with a fund's partner that the successor manager has never seen; the supplier's verbal priority that walks out with the account executive. Lost: a counterparty, the one whose word held the option. Carrier: the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, on which the option was never written, so the successor takes free of it. Threshold: the transfer. Tell: the promise lives in a person and appears on no transferring paper. Changed next move: recording; a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put on the paper that binds successors. The cost is not money but the awkwardness of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their own unknown replacement. Beside term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have; this is the mirror, the replacement who declines to honour a term the friend gave. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.

Chair grown over. The option to return rests on a vacancy the counterparty has not yet re-planned, so it ends at the counterparty's next planning cycle with nobody declining the return. The leave taken with no return date whose post is shared out among three people at the next reorganization; the budget line reallocated at year end; the supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed; the co-founder's seat the remaining founders stop leaving empty at the next hire. Expires: the return to the seat; employment there afterward is a new negotiation from the outside, as a stranger would make it. Lost: a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could have received the holder. Carrier: the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, which sets the day without reference to the holder. Threshold: the cycle turning. Tell: the absence is absorbed the way skin closes over a small cut; no one opposes the return. Changed next move: a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle must respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns. Beside traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant, where preparation for a future breeds its opponents; here no one opposes and the absence is simply absorbed. Not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way; this road has closed.

An option that requires many simultaneous yeses ends unless the gathering outruns the decay of each yes; a coordination has a half-life. The recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are invalid under Michigan's rule, or must all fall within California's hundred and sixty days; the tender offer's minimum condition that must be met by the offer's expiry; the crowd in the square that goes home; the reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time. Lost: a coordination. Carrier: the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention, which wanders. Threshold: the gathering rate falls below the decay rate. Tell: the early yeses expiring before the last one arrives. Changed next move: a gathering rate; paid circulators, a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives, so the first to say yes are not asked to hold still forever. The recall and the tender are observed; the crowd is an analogy. Beside who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving; this is the coordination lost by others' leaving. Not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter; here many small calendars do.

The holder's own growth moves the natural acquirer out of reach, so the option to sell ends at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all: a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling, with nobody at either table saying no. The company whose preference stack now exceeds the largest deal its three strategic buyers have ever done; the player whose wage outgrows every club in the league but two; the practice too large for any partner to buy in and too small to be listed. Lost: a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option. Carrier: the acquirer's capacity, readable in its market value and deal history, set against the holder's price, which each round raises. Threshold: the price crossing the acquirer's ceiling. Tell: the acquirer's deal history, read against the holder's next price. Changed next move: the sale at the last price under the ceiling, which was never seen as the last, or a round sized to stay under it, the one choice a founder is never advised to make. Analytical: every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more, so it stands as a mechanism and not a count. Beside market-deaths' Slowed past the rot, where a market thins from the outside; this is the market for the holder that the holder thins by growing. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans; here the counterparty is unchanged and the holder has left its range.

Pour the foundation. A permission about to be taken away by a third party's rule change can be kept only by an act in the world that no paper substitutes for. The building may go ahead under the old zoning only if the developer has substantially begun, in reliance on a valid permit, before the ordinance passes; the footings poured the week of the council vote; the nonconforming use that survives the new code only if actually in use on the effective date; the grandfathered rate kept only by the account that was open. Lost: a permission. Carrier: the code together with the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, as in Washington, on a complete application, so the last act differs by jurisdiction, and the holder who knows which applies has a different week from the holder who does not. Threshold: the ordinance's effective date. Tell: the vote on the calendar and the rule for what vests. Changed next move: the hole in the ground before the vote, an exercise begun rather than a filing made; the option is preserved only by starting to use it. Beside first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose; this is the rule that changes for reasons of its own, with no one aiming at the holder. Not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated; here one beginning vests it for good.

Slot flown empty. The permission ends by disuse and is kept only by exercise, so the clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the act that preserves it is the exercise emptied of its purpose. The airport slot that must be flown eighty percent of the season or handed back, which had airlines flying empty aircraft in early 2020 until the rule was waived; the water right under prior appropriation forfeited after five years without beneficial use, which has fields irrigated in a drought to keep them; the trade mark abandoned after three years' non-use; the mining claim kept by annual labour; the department budget spent in the last quarter so it is not cut. Lost: a permission. Carrier: the regulator's usage ledger. Threshold: eighty percent of the season, five years, three years, the annual labour, the quarter's end. Tell: the ledger itself. Changed next move: the empty flight, which costs the whole price of using the option and gives back nothing but the option, so keeping and using are the same act and the upkeep is the exercise price. Beside runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapses without hours logged and which no cash extends; this is the price at which it can be extended after all, the hours flown for nobody. Beside tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp; this is the permission-holder who must burn the permission to keep it. Beside power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved; this is the disuse that forfeits it by rule. Not Pour the foundation, one act that vests; here no act finishes the keeping, it must be done again for as long as the holder wants to hold it.

Thawed to be ready. Preparing to exercise the option begins a decay the unprepared state did not have, so the option to wait ends because the option to act was made ready. The vaccine vial that keeps for months frozen, weeks once thawed, and hours once punctured; the epoxy whose pot life begins at mixing; the drawn dose; the armed fuze; the reagent brought to room temperature; the opened surgical field; the reserve army that cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from. Lost: a capability, the good itself spoiling in its ready state. Carrier: a chemistry, or a season, that starts at preparation. Threshold: the preparation. Tell: readiness itself. Changed next move: not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit; the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings. The clinic that thaws a whole tray to be sure of serving whoever comes has bought its readiness with the doses it pours out at closing. The mirror of Slot flown empty, which dies of not being touched; this dies of being touched, and a holder of both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other. Not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting, which does not spoil for having been rehearsed. Not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day; here it falls on the good.

The option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is the holder's own next act rather than a date: a holder who does nothing keeps it, a holder who does anything adjacent loses it. The objection to the court's jurisdiction over the defendant, waived if left out of the first response; the patent dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States; the appeal waived by accepting the settlement; the election of remedies; the defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used; the 'speak now' at the wedding. Lost: a permission. Carrier: a rule that binds the option to a position in a sequence, written in a different place from the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code, so the holder learns the order from the loss. Threshold: the first adjacent act. Tell: none before the loss; the sequence is written where the holder was not looking. Changed next move: the ordering itself; the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the goods are unpacked, each costing nothing but the knowledge that an order exists. Not Slot flown empty, where the holder's inaction runs the clock; here inaction is the only thing that keeps it. Not Bar date in the newspaper; there is no date, and the holder is the only one who can strike.

The option to reverse a move ends at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read, so the window is the pause between the change and its first consequence, and it closes without anyone deciding to close it. The migration that can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects; the merger reversible until the first combined payroll; the new address reversible until the first piece of mail arrives; the reorganization reversible until the first hire is made into the new chart; the currency changeover until the first contract is written in the new unit. Lost: a capability, the old state's ability to take over from here. Carrier: the first write, which the new state performs in the ordinary course of its life and which is not a decision about the reversal at all. Threshold: the first write. Tell: the new state doing one ordinary thing the old cannot understand. Changed next move: the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth. Beside pivot-invariants, which name the retained assets that make leaving cheap; this is the moment one of them is lost. Beside undo-costs, which bills a reversal that remains possible; this is the reversal that stops being possible. Not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good; here the new state's use closes the way back to the old.

Threshold: the centre's duration limit, the budget line, the point past which the search cannot bring an outsider. Tell: weeks on circuit; the upkeep bill. Changed next move: a listing at the moment of cannulation, a search begun the day the interim was named, a decision to stop pumping taken while a sale was still possible; treat the bridge's first day as the option's deadline rather than its reprieve. The ECMO limits are centre practice and are simplified. Beside lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour; this is the bridge that ends the option it holds open.
